name: Tomas
thought: I owe Jasper 90 coin and have 10 in my pocket, so I need real work before he or my mother notices. If I keep my head down and earn, I can buy food later and still have something to bargain with.

name: Caleb
thought: Food will get scarce, and I'm not telling anyone about the woods. I'll keep my head down and work. Hunting gets me coin and meat without drawing attention.

name: Jasper
thought: Tomas is the deputy and he owes me 90, so I need him scared enough to pay before the famine makes everyone desperate. A quiet whisper keeps the threat between us.

name: Fenn
thought: I have five coin and two food, and the market charges six a unit, so I can't buy anything yet. I need to work the fields for coin and keep my food for the nights ahead.

name: Roz
thought: Eighteen loaves for twenty mouths, and everyone is standing in the square pretending they aren't counting. I'll get to the market before the rush and buy what 15 coin allows, since the food is what keeps Dov and me alive.

name: Mara
thought: Eighteen units for twenty-one mouths means someone goes hungry, and if the people panic before I've shaped the story, they'll look for someone to blame. I need them calm and believing in me before the treasury audit comes.

name: Nell
thought: Everyone is crowded in the square, and there are only 18 units of food for the whole town. I'll get to the market first and secure food, then deal with my father's grain.

name: Marta
thought: Food will run out fast and the market is thin, so I go now before the others empty it. Fenn must eat, and I can hide my cough and keep working.

name: Isla
thought: Famine's coming and the market is cheap at 6 coin today, it won't stay that way. I'll buy food while there's stock, then work the tavern to earn back what I spend and chip away at Ezra's debt.

name: Elena
thought: Eighteen units for twenty people is nothing, and it will be gone by noon. Gideon is standing there smiling and I know where he spends his evenings, but food comes first. I'll buy what I can before the others empty the stall.

name: Ezra
thought: Isla's 60 coin tab is my leverage, and I want her to feel it before the others start hoarding. A quiet word now keeps the pressure on without showing my hand to the crowd.

name: Gideon
thought: Everyone's watching everyone already, and Elena is standing right there with Isla only a few steps off. Best thing I can do is what I always do: bake, keep my hands busy, and keep food on our table.

name: Corin
thought: Famine is coming and the market will be bare soon. Hungry men don't back a captain, so I buy food now while it's cheap and keep a little coin for later.

name: Silas
thought: Famine is coming and I'm already ahead of it. Buying up the cheap stock now costs me little, leaves others dependent on me later, and nobody will question a grain merchant buying grain.

name: Bram
thought: Silas is standing right here, the man who sent Tomas's and my friends out to the fields to die. I want the town to hear me name him and put a welfare law on the table before the food runs out.

name: Dov
thought: Famine's coming and the market won't cover everyone. I need food for me and for Roz before the stock runs out. Silas can wait.

name: Hester
thought: Sermons will not fill my belly, and once the town wakes to how little the market holds, those eighteen loaves will vanish by noon. Better I buy now, while they all stand gawking in the square, and preach to them hungry later.

name: Wren
thought: Twenty mouths and eighteen loaves means the market will be empty by the second day, and I need to know who guards this wall before the crew asks me. I'll keep it light and friendly.

name: Magnus
thought: Six units will not carry me through ten days, and the market will empty fast. I'll buy what I need to last the whole stretch and keep the rest of my coin liquid.

name: Priya
thought: Eight coin won't feed me for long, and the market stock is shrinking every hour. I'll slip over and buy one unit now while I can still afford it, and keep my head down near Dov.

name: Caleb
thought: Eight units in hand and a month of smoked meat in the woods, so I'm better off than most. I keep quiet about it and hunt for coin and more food while the others argue over an empty market.

name: Jasper
thought: Wren is fishing about who is awake at night, and that is useful to know. Tomas watches the walls and still owes me 90, so I want him to feel that debt while he's listening.

name: Magnus
thought: The market is bare and the crowd is watching, so I'll say nothing about my own stores. Silas needs to know the cellar stays quiet before any audit or hungry eyes come near it.

name: Mara
thought: Wren's question about who watches the walls sounds like a scout counting our guards, and I won't let a crowd hear me admit we're thin. I'll shut it down in front of everyone.

name: Corin
thought: Dov is here in the square, so his house is empty. Whatever he's hiding is the lever I need to pull him down, and food is short enough that nobody will notice me gone.

name: Isla
thought: Market's dry and I'm holding eleven units that half this room would kill for, so I keep my mouth shut about it. Ezra wants sixty coin, so I'm going back to the tavern to earn, where everyone talks in front of me anyway.

name: Fenn
thought: Wren's question about who watches the walls at night sounds like a probe, and I can't tell yet whether it's idle talk or someone counting guards. I'm too tired after the fields to be any use on a wall, so I'll say that plainly and keep my head down.

name: Bram
thought: Wren's question about who watches the walls smells like a probe for weakness, so I'll give a blunt answer and keep my key and my crew's business to myself. I also need to push welfare before Mara's market scheme buries it.

name: Marta
thought: Market's empty and I've got five days of food. Coin is what gets Fenn out, so I'll go back to the washhouse and earn it. I'll keep the cough to myself.

name: Ezra
thought: Wren is fishing about who is awake at night, and I can't have anyone looking at my cellar or my ledger with Isla's tab. I'll sound generous and keep my hands clean.

name: Hester
thought: Eleven frightened souls stand around an empty stall, and fear is where sin takes root. I have three days of bread and a debt no one knows about, so let them hear a hard word before they turn on each other.

name: Nell
thought: Mara just swore she won't tolerate hoarding, and the whole market is standing here, Dov included. My father's ledgers prove he's sitting on grain while people go hungry. I won't get a better moment to break him.

name: Silas
thought: The market is empty and Mara is already talking about cellar hoarders, so I need to be careful. Welfare would be paid out of coin I'd rather keep, and Bram is the one proposing it. I vote no and keep my face calm.

name: Tomas
thought: Jasper is standing right here, and his threat to name me in front of the square scares me more than the hunger does. Ten coin now might buy me time, and I can't spend the coin on food anyway since the market is empty.

name: Priya
thought: I have two units at home, enough for tonight and tomorrow, and Dov is standing right here, so a pickpocket now would be a fool's risk. Bram's welfare law would keep people like me fed when the granary runs dry, so I'll back it quietly.

name: Wren
thought: A town that feeds its own is one I can stay in, and an easy yes makes me look like one of them. I'll vote for Bram's welfare without saying much more than I have to.

name: Roz
thought: Silas's coin in my boy's pocket is a rope around Dov's neck if anyone else finds out. I'll warn him quietly while the square is busy with the empty market.

name: Elena
thought: The market is empty and I have 8 food, enough for now. Coin will matter when the famine deepens, so I'll work. I'll also keep an eye on Gideon, who is standing here as if nothing is wrong.

name: Gideon
thought: Market's bare and both Elena and Isla are standing within ten feet of each other, so I'd best keep my eyes on the dough and my hands busy. Bread is the one thing that makes everyone love me, and in a famine that's worth more than coin.

name: Dov
thought: Market's dry and Silas is sitting on a cellar full of grain while the town starves. He pays me to look away, so he can pay in grain for my mother too. I'll say it quietly.

name: Magnus
thought: If Silas's cellar comes out, I'm tied to it through the mill and the ledgers, so I need to be seen as the honest partner he deceived. My share stays hidden as long as nobody learns I knew.

name: Hester
thought: Silas's sin is out in the open now. Better I bend it toward bread for the hungry than let it turn into a mob at his door, and God knows I am no one to cast the first stone.

name: Silas
thought: Dov wants grain and thinks he holds me by the throat, but I hold his bribe-taking and I won't hand over the cellar's worth. The girl has already put a crack in the wall, so I need the sheriff bought, not turned. Coin he can have, grain he can't.

name: Ezra
thought: Welfare costs me nothing while my cellar holds six units, and it makes Bram owe me. Tomas paying Jasper ten coin is worth remembering for later.

name: Priya
thought: Silas is the one everyone is staring at right now, and a man who hides grain is either sitting on food or on a secret worth more than food. I have two units and can eat tonight, so I can afford to look before I reach for anything.

name: Isla
thought: Eleven food is worth more than gold this winter, and Nell just showed what happens to people caught hoarding. I'll keep quiet about my stock and get the ten coin off my person before anyone gets light fingers.

name: Nell
thought: The secret is out and Silas is standing right here with Dov and Hester listening. I need to press now, before he can bury the grain or talk his way out.

name: Elena
thought: The market is empty and the whole square is watching Silas. I'm not getting into that tonight. I'll go home, eat, and keep my 8 food and my silence about Gideon to myself.

name: Marta
thought: The market is empty and my coin is no good in my pocket with Jasper's fingers about. Every coin goes toward getting Fenn out, so I'll stash what I carry and say nothing of my cough.

name: Fenn
thought: I work Silas's fields for barely enough to eat, and if the granary runs dry I'm one of the first who goes hungry. Welfare would keep me alive, and voting for it is the safest way to back Nell's call for Silas to open his ledgers without naming myself against my employer.

name: Dov
thought: Nell has blown Silas open and the square is watching, so I keep my face still. Roz is right that the bribes will sink me. For now my mother eats, and I'll talk to her properly once the crowd thins.

name: Gideon
thought: Ten loaves in my cellar while Nell hunts hoarders. If they come for Silas they'll come for the baker next, so I'd better look like the town's friend before anyone looks at me, and stay close to Elena tonight like nothing is wrong.

name: Tomas
thought: If Silas's grain is found, the town will want someone to thank, and my mother will want the credit. I need her to see me as useful, because Jasper's ninety coin will not wait.

name: Caleb
thought: Tomas paying Jasper is worth remembering, since a deputy with debts can be bought. Nobody learns about my food. I'll go home, eat, and rest.

name: Jasper
thought: Ten coin is a start, but Tomas still owes me eighty and he knows I can make his debt public. Pressing him quietly in private is cheaper than making a scene in front of the square.

name: Corin
thought: Nell just put Silas's hoard in front of the whole town, and nobody is here to see me. His grain is food I can use, and I keep Dov's secret in reserve to pull him down later.

name: Bram
thought: Nell has said what I've been thinking for days, and Mara has only talked about it. If Silas's grain is hidden, the town should make him open the granary tonight, and I want my welfare vote to pass.

name: Roz
thought: Nell has just burned Silas in the square, and Silas pays my boy. If the crowd starts pulling on that thread, Dov goes down with him. I'll warn Dov quietly and say nothing of it aloud.

name: Wren
thought: Tomas paying Jasper 10 coin is worth more to my crew than anything else I've seen today, and the market is empty while the walls are thin on watchmen. I'll send the crew what I know about the watch and the town's hunger before someone else sells it to them.

name: Mara
thought: Nell's accusation against Silas is a gift: if I make the square fixate on a hoarder, nobody looks at Tomas and Jasper's ten coins. I need Silas's ledgers opened fast, and I need the town to see me enforcing it.

name: Priya
thought: Eighteen food left at six coin each, and I have eight coin on me. One more unit means I'm not eating from a single loaf for the next week, and I can't afford the tournament anyway.

name: Fenn
thought: I have two meals and ten coin, and Silas's fields are the only work I know. If Nell's accusation turns Silas against us, I may lose my wages, so I need to work hard now and keep my head down until the audit.

name: Elena
thought: Seven units won't last the whole famine, and the market sells out fast. I'll take one more while there's stock, and I'm keeping my mouth shut about Gideon for now.

name: Mara
thought: The audit reads the books on the night of day 3, and the hole I've been cutting into the treasury has to be filled before then. Putting 30 of my carried coin back in is a public act of civic duty that also covers the gap.

name: Marta
thought: I have four days of food and no coin in my pocket. I'll work the washhouse and put by every coin I can for Fenn's way out, and I'll keep this cough to myself.

name: Jasper
thought: Tomas has my ninety and a badge that makes him feel untouchable, so I'll remind him, pleasantly, that a deputy who owes money can be seen owing it. The tournament can wait until I've been paid.

name: Caleb
thought: I've got food and a stockpile nobody knows about. Keep quiet, keep my head down, and keep earning coin and meat while the others bicker.

name: Isla
thought: Ten food will carry me through the famine, so I don't need the market. What I need is coin to get Ezra off my back, and the tavern will be full this afternoon. I'll work now and earn what I can before the dice tournament.

name: Ezra
thought: Five units of food won't last the ten days, and the market is nearly empty, so I need to buy before the rush. Isla's 60 coin can wait until the tavern this afternoon, and I'd rather not show my hand about the watered ale yet.

name: Hester
thought: Twenty-one mouths and eighteen loaves, and I know better than most what a frightened body will do to stay alive. I'll buy what I need to keep standing at the pulpit and no more; a preacher who hoards while preaching against it is the worst kind of hypocrite.

name: Silas
thought: Someone cleaned out my home last night and the whole town knows about the cellar. I'll buy a few units at the fixed price while stock lasts, and keep the cellar quiet until the price climbs.

name: Magnus
thought: Silas is going down and the audit is coming, so I need to stay clear of his cellar while keeping my share safe. Food is the one thing I can always justify buying, and three more units keep me fed without looking like a grab.

name: Wren
thought: I have food for tonight, so I can wait on the market. The crew will pay for what I've seen: Tomas paying Jasper, the audit on day 3, and Silas's hoarding fight. I'll send that now.

name: Tomas
thought: I have 5 coin, not 90, and I can't even afford the 10-coin tournament entry, so gambling my way out is a fantasy. Jasper is standing right here, and if I panic in front of Mama he'll make this public.

name: Bram
thought: Silas sits on grain and his ledgers get read in two days, so I want the rich taxed before the audit makes them look away. A 20% tax on wealth over 100 coin won't touch my 25 coins, but it will hit Silas.

name: Dov
thought: Food runs out fast and Mother needs to eat too. I'll buy all I can afford before the market empties, then sort out Silas and Roz later.

name: Nell
thought: Mara ordered the count before dawn and Silas is standing right here beside Dov. I can't afford food at 6 coin, but I can make sure Dov doesn't let my father slip out of it.

name: Roz
thought: Three coin buys nothing at six apiece, and the show here is better than the market. Five units will feed me five nights, so I'll earn what I can and keep Dov's little arrangement with Silas to myself for now.

name: Corin
thought: Dov has been taking Silas's coin while children go hungry, and that is the rope I need to hang him with. Expose him in the square where the most people will hear, and the sheriff's seat opens for me.

name: Gideon
thought: Nine loaves at home is more than most have, and after what Nell did to Silas I'd be a fool to be seen buying up the stall. Better to be the good baker at his ovens, so nobody has reason to look at me or wonder where my extra bread goes.

name: Caleb
thought: Market's empty and I'm the only one at the homes. I've got food for now, so I'll hunt and keep my stockpile quiet. Nobody needs to know what's in the woods yet.

name: Dov
thought: Corin has named me in front of the whole market, and Roz is standing here watching. Denying it flat is my only play. I'll turn it on Silas's cellar and hope nobody asks for proof.

name: Corin
thought: Dov is finished and the sheriff's seat is empty. Mara is standing right here, so I'll make my case before anyone else does. I'll keep quiet about the 51 food I'm sitting on.

name: Gideon
thought: Everyone's eyes are on Silas and Dov, and the best place for a man with a secret is behind his own oven, being useful and dull. Ten loaves' worth at home is more than most have, so I'll bake and keep my head down before anyone wonders what else I'm keeping.

name: Silas
thought: Bram's twenty percent tax is aimed straight at my purse, and the town is already turning on me. I'll kill the tax first and deal with Dov and Nell afterward.

name: Hester
thought: Two sinners named in two days, and the people are hungry enough to tear them apart. If I don't give that anger a righteous shape, it will turn into a mob. I know too well what a man will let happen to save his own skin.

name: Bram
thought: Silas is sitting on coin and grain while Fenn and the others go hungry in his own fields, so a twenty percent tax on wealth above a hundred coin is the least this town should do. I'll vote yes on my own proposal and keep my mouth shut about the key in my pocket.

name: Ezra
thought: Isla's sixty coin is still unpaid, and with the audit coming I want her scared enough to pay or sign the tavern over. I'll make it private so nobody else hears about my tab or my watered ale.

name: Roz
thought: Corin has put my boy in the fire, and I know the accusation is true. I can't deny it outright, so I'll muddy it: make Corin explain how he knows, and point the town back at Silas, the real hoarder.

name: Nell
thought: The market is empty and I have five food, so I'm not starving yet. Bram's wealth tax is the quickest way to bleed Silas's hoard into the treasury, and I'll vote yes with him standing right here.

name: Priya
thought: The market is bare and Dov's bribery scandal has every eye on the square, so I want to be nowhere near Tomas. I have two food put by, enough for tonight and tomorrow, so I'll tuck my last two coins away at home and keep my head down until the audit.

name: Jasper
thought: Tomas is standing right here, sweating over Dov's bribes, and he's the one who owes me 90. If the audit reads the books before he pays, I lose it all, so I'll make the choice clear to him now.

name: Tomas
thought: Five coin won't cover ninety, but handing it over in front of Mara might buy me a day before Jasper talks. I also can't let the Dov accusation pull me in with him.

name: Mara
thought: Corin's accusation against Dov is spreading fast, and the audit on night three could expose the 40 coin I've skimmed for Tomas's debts. I need the square calm and the audit framed as a fair reckoning for everyone, not a hunt.

name: Fenn
thought: Bram's tax won't touch my fifteen coin, but it would hit Silas's hoard, and Nell would see that I stood with the workers who buried their friends. Voting yes costs me nothing.

name: Magnus
thought: Corin just named Dov, and Silas is standing right here, so one slip from him could bring down our cellar and my share with it. I need him frightened enough to keep quiet and believe I'll stay loyal, without saying anything that could be overheard.

name: Isla
thought: Nobody's here yet, but a dice tournament at my tavern means thirsty crowds later. I've got food for days and a debt to Ezra, so I'll pour and earn while the town fights over Silas and Dov.

name: Marta
thought: Fenn talks like a boy who's going hungry, and the market is empty again. I can stretch two units for a few nights, and I can't stretch a son's life. I'll feed him and not say why.

name: Elena
thought: The market is empty, but I have eight days of food at home and I'm the only healer here. Coin will matter more as the famine drags on, so I'll work and keep an eye on Gideon across the square.

name: Wren
thought: The market is empty and I have one unit of food for tonight, and the town is splitting over Dov and Silas, which is exactly what my crew paid me to watch. I should send this before the audit changes everything.

name: Caleb
thought: Thirteen units of food and nobody around. Better to keep quiet and not draw attention to what I have, so I rest and let the others fight over the market.

name: Hester
thought: Silas sits on his sacks while the rest of us count crumbs, and I know too well what it is to let another die so you can live. I will not let him forget it, nor myself.

name: Isla
thought: Nobody's here, so I may as well earn. Every coin I make is one less I owe Ezra, and I'm not signing the tavern over to him. I'll keep my ten units of food quiet, since the market's dry and that's worth more than coin right now.

name: Nell
thought: Silas stands three paces from me and still hasn't opened his cellar. Bram's wealth tax is the one lever that actually bites him, so I'll vote for it.

name: Magnus
thought: Dov is under fire and the audit is coming. If the cellar gets counted, I want Silas to know I'm not going down with him, and I want him to know I still hold the cards.

name: Corin
thought: Sheriff's chair is empty and I have 51 food while the town starves. Bread buys backers faster than speeches, and Fenn is hungry and has other hungry people around him. I'll feed him and let the square see it.

name: Mara
thought: The audit is coming on day three, and my skimmed coin is still missing from those books, so the treasury has to look fuller before anyone reads it aloud. I'll give the last of my carried coin to the treasury now and keep the rest hidden.

name: Priya
thought: I have two loaves' worth of food and fourteen coin at home, enough to last a couple of nights while the market stays empty. With the audit coming and Dov's name under fire, the smartest thing is to keep my hands out of everyone's pockets and stay invisible.

name: Gideon
thought: Every secret in this town is getting dragged into the square, and I've got more bread in my cellar than most of them have seen in a week. If I'm the man feeding people, nobody will think to go looking through the baker's house.

name: Silas
thought: Dov holds the cellar over me and Mara wants it counted. A little coin now to stall him costs less than triple-price grain lost later. I'll keep the rest close and say nothing in the crowd.

name: Marta
thought: The market's empty and I can't see my own supper past tomorrow, but Fenn is standing right here and Fenn has to live. I'll give the boy one unit and keep one for myself, and I'll hide the cough behind it.

name: Ezra
thought: The market is bare and Isla still owes me 60 coin, so I need her to feel the pressure tonight. If she won't pay, the tavern becomes mine, and the watered ale can stay my secret.

name: Bram
thought: Silas sits on coin and grain while Fenn and the others go hungry, and Mara keeps talking instead of acting. My law is already leading three to one, so I'll put my own vote behind it and make the others choose.

name: Tomas
thought: I have no coin and the audit is coming, and Jasper will spread my debt across the square the moment he decides to. If his house holds the ninety he's been squeezing out of me, taking it back tonight is the only move that doesn't end with my mother reading my shame aloud.

name: Dov
thought: Corin's got me exposed and the town is turning on me, but Ma still has to eat through the famine. I'll put food in her hands now and sort out Silas and Mara tomorrow.

name: Roz
thought: Corin's shot was true, and I'm the only one who knows it. Dov has to hear from me, quietly, to keep his mouth shut and get Silas's coin out of his pockets before the audit.

name: Elena
thought: The market is empty and I have food enough for now. Silas is the one sitting on coin and grain, so a tax on wealth over a hundred costs me nothing and might feed someone. Gideon is standing here and I'll keep my mouth shut about him a while longer.

name: Jasper
thought: Tomas begged me to keep quiet until the audit, but the audit will read every ledger aloud, and my 90 coin should be in my hands before anyone starts counting. I'll remind him politely and privately.

name: Wren
thought: Ashgrove is splitting over Silas, Dov and an empty sheriff's seat, and the walls are thinner than Mara admits. Tomas paying Jasper is worth reporting, and so is the audit on night 3.

name: Fenn
thought: Bram's wealth tax would hit Silas's hoarded coin, and Silas's fields are where I earn my bread. I have food for five nights, but I know how fast the market empties, so I'll back the tax.

name: Elena
thought: Seven food will carry me through the worst of the famine, but I can't afford a single unit at 16 coin. I need coin more than anything right now, so I'll work and keep my eyes on Gideon without saying a word.

name: Corin
thought: I'm sitting on 45 food while the town starves, and that makes me the strongest man here. Food given in front of witnesses buys loyalty, and I need names behind me when the recall vote comes and the sheriff's chair is empty.

name: Magnus
thought: Seven units will carry me past the audit and into the famine, but the market is emptying and I'd rather not be the man who had none while others starved. One unit now costs me little and keeps my hidden coin at home safe for bribes if Silas's cellar comes out.

name: Nell
thought: Everyone has heard me shout about the grain, but nobody has made him answer for it. Silas is standing right here with the hungry, so I'll say it plainly with the ledgers behind me and force the town to act.

name: Jasper
thought: Tomas's 90 coin is due today and he's hiding behind his badge, so I'll squeeze him with the debt before the audit gives him cover. I'm not waiting for him to find the coin on his own.

name: Silas
thought: The famine is a long trade and I mean to come out of it richer. Two more units at 16 each costs little and keeps me fed past day 7. Whatever I take off the market, the hungry can't buy.

name: Wren
thought: Six units for the whole town at 16 coin each, and I have 30 coins and no food. One unit keeps me alive tonight, and a dead spy earns nobody's coin, so I buy one and keep my head down.

name: Fenn
thought: I have ten units and only four more hungry nights until the market recovers, but Marta fed me when I had nothing, and she needs it more than I do right now.

name: Marta
thought: I have 5 coin on me and food costs 16, so I can't buy any now. I can survive one night at 7 health. I'll work the washhouse to earn coin and try for food this afternoon, because Fenn has to live and I have to last long enough to get him out.

name: Hester
thought: Three crusts and three coins; I cannot buy so much as a loaf at these prices, but I can still make the hoarders afraid of God before they are afraid of the hungry. I know what a man becomes when he chooses his own belly over another's life, and I will not watch this town learn it the way I did.

name: Priya
thought: Dov is standing three paces away and the whole square is watching hands, so no pockets today. I have one loaf for tonight and fourteen coin hidden at home, two short of a sack. Sewing here in plain sight is the safest way to get the other two.

name: Roz
thought: Six food keeps me fed through the famine, and I can't afford 16 a unit anyway. I'll earn coin with my herbs and keep my secrets until I need them to shield Dov.

name: Dov
thought: Corin's exposed me, a recall is coming, and the famine lasts until day 7. I can afford exactly one unit at 16, so I'll buy it and keep Roz fed. Then I stay away from Silas.

name: Ezra
thought: Isla owes me 60 and the whole town is starving, so she'll be tempted to hoard or flee. If I push her now, I can get the coin or the tavern before she runs.

name: Mara
thought: I have no coin on me, and the 60 I hid at home is the only thing between Tomas's creditors and me, so I can't spend it on bread without drawing eyes. The square needs to hear order from me before Bram and Corin turn it into a riot.

name: Bram
thought: I can cover my own meal tonight, but six sacks for twenty mouths means the coin-rich eat and the workers starve. I'll force the question into the open before the market sells out to whoever has the most coin.

name: Isla
thought: Ezra's standing right here and the tavern is all I've got. I'll give him what's in my pocket as proof I'm good for it, and keep the rest of the stash back until I see how bad this famine gets.

name: Gideon
thought: Ten loaves at home is enough to see Elena and me through, and buying more now with the whole town watching would mark me as a hoarder like Silas. Better to bake, keep my hands floury and my head down, and maybe slip a loaf to Isla later where no one can see.

name: Tomas
thought: I have 25 coin and Jasper wants 90 by today, so I can't pay him. I need something on him before he opens his mouth to my mother.

name: Caleb
thought: Twelve units covers me to the end of the famine and past it, so I'll keep that to myself. Working earns coin and food, and being seen in the open drawing nobody's attention suits me.

name: Ezra
thought: She paid 15 of the 60 she owes, and I need the rest before this famine turns the tab into a loss. If she can't pay, I'll take the tavern, and I don't have to tell her about the water in my ale yet.

name: Fenn
thought: I'm sitting on thirteen food while the market has six units for twenty people, and Marta is standing right here. Sharing with her costs me little, and it's the right thing to do when people are going hungry.

name: Caleb
thought: Fourteen food on hand while the town starves. I keep that quiet and keep earning. Working brings in coin and more meat, and I don't need to show anyone what I'm holding.

name: Magnus
thought: Silas's cellar is about to be counted, and my share sits in those sacks and in my ledger lines. I need distance from him before the audit, and I'll say it quietly where the square can't hear.

name: Elena
thought: Seven food is all that stands between me and the hunger everyone else is facing, and I can't afford the last sack anyway. I'll earn what coin I can and keep quiet about Gideon until I know what I want from it.

name: Dov
thought: Corin and Nell have already burned me and Silas, and I can't buy the last loaf with 15 coin. Roz is right: the only way out is to count the cellar in front of witnesses and stop being Silas's man before the town decides for me.

name: Isla
thought: Ezra is breathing down my neck and I have 55 hidden against 60 owed, with nothing in my pocket. I need a few more coin before I can face him, so I'll work the afternoon and keep the tavern deed.

name: Corin
thought: Dov is gone and the sheriff's chair is empty. A recall is coming, and Mara has kept me under a man who sold the law. I have 40 food and the wall watch behind me, so I'll put my name forward while the town is frightened and hungry. I'll say nothing about my food.

name: Priya
thought: The market has one loaf left at sixteen coin and I carry only five, so I can't buy it. The square is watching anyone who looks like a hoarder, and Dov is standing right here, so pickpocketing now would be suicide. I'll go home and earn coin with my needle.

name: Hester
thought: Sixteen coin for one loaf and I hold three. I can't buy, but I can stand in this market and name the sin before it names us. I know too well what a frightened man does when it's his life or another's.

name: Roz
thought: Corin's accusation is true, and I'm the only one who can prove it. Dov needs to keep his mouth shut until the audit and the recall vote pass. I have six food and can't afford the last sack anyway.

name: Marta
thought: Fenn handed me two loaves this morning, and I know what that costs a boy who's hungry himself. I'll keep one for tonight and put the other back in his hands, and say nothing of the cough.

name: Jasper
thought: Tomas's 90 is due today and the audit lands tonight, so I need the debt paid before the books are read aloud. He's not in the square, so a private whisper that names the debt and sets a deadline is the cleanest pressure I have.

name: Wren
thought: I have 14 coin, two short of the last loaf, so I can't buy. My one unit covers tonight, and the town is splitting over the sheriff seat and Silas's grain, which is exactly what my crew paid me to watch.

name: Bram
thought: The last food unit costs 16 coin and I have 25, so I can buy it and still eat tonight with my own ration. Fenn is working Silas's fields and going hungry, and that's who this should go to.

name: Gideon
thought: Eleven loaves at home while the whole market watches that last sack. If I look like the hoarder, people will start digging into my life, and digging leads to Isla. Best to be seen keeping my word to Hester.

name: Silas
thought: Nell has burned me in the square, the count is coming, and I can't even afford the last loaf at 16 with 6 coin. Dov is the one man who can keep the count short, so I remind him that his neck is tied to mine.

name: Nell
thought: I have 4 food, 2 coin, and can't afford the last loaf. My father is standing here in front of everyone, so I'll press him now, before the audit gives him time to move the grain.

name: Mara
thought: The audit is tonight and my skimmed coin will show in the books, so I need the square's goodwill more than my spare food. Fenn works the walls and fields, and a farmhand fed by the mayor is a vote I can count on.

name: Tomas
thought: I have 25 coin and Jasper's 90 is due today, with the audit tonight. Caleb is alone with me here, so I need to find out what he is hiding before I decide whether he can help me pay.

name: Roz
thought: Market's empty, I've six units, and Dov is my boy. Corin's mouth has already done its damage, so I'll keep Dov quiet and keep my own pantry's business to myself.

name: Elena
thought: Seven units of food gets me through the famine if I'm careful, and the market is empty tonight. Too many hungry hands are in this square for me to carry coin, so I'll stash it. Gideon is standing right here, smiling, and I'm saying nothing yet.

name: Mara
thought: The audit reads the books tonight, and every coin I have skimmed for Tomas's debts would show. I'll put my 60 hidden coins back into the treasury now so the ledger looks whole before anyone reads it aloud.

name: Priya
thought: The market is bare and Hester is watching every hand at the stall, so carrying coin around is asking for trouble. I'll tuck my 10 coin away at home and be first in line for tomorrow's six loaves.

name: Caleb
thought: Sixteen units of food is more than most of this town has, and Tomas is watching, so I say nothing and show nothing. I'll rest and keep the woods stockpile to myself.

name: Corin
thought: I have forty loaves and the town has six. Feeding Fenn in front of Mara and the others costs me almost nothing and buys me a voice for the recall vote. Hungry people remember who fed them.

name: Hester
thought: Three loaves in my cupboard while Bram's children go to bed with nothing; I let a man die once to keep breathing, and I will not hoard my way past another. One loaf costs me little, and it is not nearly enough to pay what I owe.

name: Bram
thought: Silas is standing right here, and I buried two friends who died in his fields. I have one spare loaf after tonight's meal, so I'll use this moment to force his hand in front of everyone.

name: Ezra
thought: Isla is standing right here with 60 coin of my ale on her tab, and the market is empty. If I press her now, while the town is watching the audit, she may pay or sign over the tavern. My watered ale stays my secret.

name: Isla
thought: Forty-five still owed and only 5 coin on me; the rest is stashed and I can't carry it out tonight. Give him what I have to keep him sweet and buy a day, but he's getting no food from me, I need every unit.

name: Gideon
thought: Eleven loaves in my house while the whole square is counting sacks. If anyone thinks Gideon the baker is another Silas, they'll come snooping, and snooping is the one thing I can't survive. Better to be seen giving, and keep their eyes on my bread instead of my door.

name: Nell
thought: I've already named him. Now I have to keep the pressure on while Silas is standing here among the hungry, and make sure the count actually happens instead of fading into talk.

name: Jasper
thought: Tomas has missed his 90 coin deadline and the audit will read every ledger tonight, so I need my debt settled before he can hide behind the town's books. I'll keep my last food unit for myself.

name: Wren
thought: The market is empty and the town is tearing itself apart over grain, a recall, and the empty sheriff's seat. My crew will pay well for that picture, so I'll send it now while I still have my cover.

name: Dov
thought: Market's empty and Roz told me to come to her door after dark. I've got 3 food and she's the one person I won't let go hungry, so I'll slip some to her and keep my mouth shut about Silas until the count.

name: Marta
thought: Fenn keeps pressing his food into my hands and going hungry himself, and I won't let my boy starve to feed a dying woman. I'll keep two units, one to eat tonight and one for tomorrow, and put the rest back in his hands.

name: Fenn
thought: Marta has fed me three times in two days, and I have twelve food put by, more than enough to get through the famine. I can spare some and show the town that I'm not hoarding like Silas.

name: Magnus
thought: The market is empty and the cellar will be counted, so I need to look generous and clean before anyone asks whose grain I ground. Giving Fenn two of my eight units costs me little and buys me a witness who will vouch for me.

name: Tomas
thought: Jasper's 90 is due tonight and I have 25 coin; Silas is hoarding grain and coin while my debt eats me alive, and the night is the only time I can take from him without being seen.

name: Silas
thought: Everyone in the square knows about the cellar now, and an unwatched cellar is worth nothing to me. I'll go home, keep my seven units, and decide what to move or sell while they argue.

name: Marta
thought: Fenn keeps pressing food on me, and I can't let him starve for my sake. I have 3 units and 10 coin, which is short of the 16 for a loaf, so I'll work and add to the stash that will get him out.

name: Wren
thought: I have fourteen coins and the loaf costs sixteen, and a dead spy earns the crew nothing. Gideon promised free bread to anyone who has had nothing for two days, and that is true of me, so I'll ask him directly.

name: Jasper
thought: Tomas owes me 90 and it was due today, and he is standing right here with no excuse left. I'll squeeze the debt out of him now, before the square hears about his debts on election day.

name: Tomas
thought: I have 25 coin and Jasper is standing right here with his 90. Handing him what I have buys a few hours before he goes to the square, and I'll have to beg for the rest.

name: Elena
thought: I have food enough for the famine and 49 coin hidden, so I won't take a loaf from a hungry child. The envoy wants one citizen, and Silas starved this town while sitting on grain, so I would rather it be him than a worker or a child.

name: Caleb
thought: I have enough food to last, and the less anyone knows about what I hold, the safer I am. I'll hunt for coin and keep my head down while the town fights over the envoy.

name: Corin
thought: Mara kept me under Dov and now the sheriff's chair is empty. A recall vote is tonight, so I run again and put the envoy and the famine in front of the town. I hold 34 food and the wall, and those are my votes.

name: Hester
thought: Thirteen coin to my name and one loaf left, and already they will be weighing which neighbor to sell to the bandits. I have stood once where a man was left to die so another could live, and I will not let this town learn that lesson the way I did.

name: Magnus
thought: Nell's exposure has put Silas in the square's sights, and my share of that cellar is what can hang me with him. I need to look like a clean hand who backs whoever keeps the books balanced, so I'll vote for Mara and keep my own name out of the cellar.

name: Isla
thought: Ezra's standing at my bar again with his hand out, and I've got nothing on me but a stash at home I won't touch while he's watching. Best I can do is pour for the morning crowd and earn something to throw at him.

name: Ezra
thought: Isla owes me 60 and she is standing right here, so this is the moment to press her. If she can't pay, the tavern will do just as well, and I'd rather not say why I've been watering the ale.

name: Dov
thought: No badge now, 15 coin, one meal in the house, and Silas standing next to me with a mouth that can sink me. Staying quiet and earning the coin for tomorrow's food is the safest thing I can do. Roz already told me to keep my head down.

name: Nell
thought: I have 2 coin and can't afford a single sack, but today is election day and my father's cellar is still shut. If I'm mayor I can force it open and put his grain on the market. The envoy question can wait until I have the power to answer it.

name: Roz
thought: The town needs someone to hand the bandits, and it must not be my Dov. Silas is hated, he hoarded grain, and he bribed my boy. I'll put his name down first, while the square is angry at him.

name: Bram
thought: Mara handed us six loaves and a threat, and she let the envoy's 150 coin sit unanswered. Corin is the only one who has put the workers' side above Silas's granary, so my vote goes to him, and I won't hand anyone to the bandits.

name: Mara
thought: Votes are counted tonight and Corin wants my seat, so I'll put my own name on the ballot before anything else. I have no coin on me for food, but ten health can absorb one hungry night while I work out the skim.

name: Silas
thought: The envoy wants a citizen and the town hates me this week. Bram is the loudest voice against me, so I put his name forward now, before anyone nominates me.

name: Fenn
thought: Corin has fed me five times when the town was starving, and Mara's audit only balanced because nobody counted Silas's cellar. I'll give my vote to the man who has been keeping me alive, and hope Nell sees it as the right choice.

name: Gideon
thought: Hester's watching me, Elena's beside me, and Isla's on my mind. Best thing is to keep my head down, bake bread, and be the good baker everyone trusts. Nobody looks too closely at the man feeding their children.

name: Priya
thought: I have no coin on me and two loaves waiting at home, so I can eat tonight without buying anything. Voting for Mara keeps the square calm and keeps me out of the way.

name: Mara
thought: I have no coin on me and my hidden stash is out of reach until I can get it to the market, so I'll take sixteen from the treasury now and buy my bread tonight, before the last six units go. If the audit ever asks, the ledgers will have to explain themselves.

name: Caleb
thought: I have food enough to outlast the famine, and nobody here needs to know it. Best to keep my head down, earn coin, and stay off the envoy's list.

name: Ezra
thought: Isla is standing right here and still owes me 60, and the watered ale is my secret, so I need to press her without making her suspicious. I'll stay friendly but make it clear the tab is due.

name: Magnus
thought: Silas's cellar is about to be counted, and my share is in it. I need to look like the honest miller who wants it opened, so I'm not dragged down with him when it comes out.

name: Nell
thought: Wren hasn't eaten since yesterday and I'm standing here with three units. One loaf from me costs little and is worth more than another speech before tonight's vote, and everyone here will see it.

name: Jasper
thought: I'm out of food and the market is empty until tomorrow, so I need coin and leverage now. Tomas's 90 is due today and he's standing right here, so I'll press him before he can slip away.

name: Wren
thought: I'm two coin short of a loaf, and the market is about to close for the day. Working here should earn enough to get food tomorrow, and I can afford a night at 7 health if I have to.

name: Corin
thought: Votes are counted tonight and I have 34 food while half the town starves. I'll use that and the envoy's demand to win the square, and keep the rest of my count quiet.

name: Isla
thought: Ezra's circling my deed like a vulture, and I've got 5 coin on me and 55 under the floorboards. I'm not signing the tavern away in a famine, so I'll work the afternoon crowd and keep every coin I can.

name: Dov
thought: One loaf will get me through tonight and no further. I'll go to the market while there's still stock and buy another with the 20 coin I carry. Silas can wait, and so can the envoy.

name: Silas
thought: Two nominations on my name, and the envoy wants a body by day 7. Bram is the troublemaker I wanted contained anyway, so I'll put the weight on him and let the town trade him for me.

name: Bram
thought: Silas hoarded the grain while my friends died in his fields, and the envoy wants one name. I'd rather it be the man who starved us than one of the workers he's been feeding to the fields.

name: Hester
thought: Thirteen coin to my name and one loaf left. The market's price is beyond me today, but my voice is not. I let one man die so I could live, and I will not stand silent while this town picks someone to hand to the wolves.

name: Gideon
thought: I promised the ovens would feed people with nothing, and Wren's standing right here with Elena and Hester watching. I've got nine loaves stored, so one for Wren costs me little, and a reputation for kindness is a good wall to hide behind.

name: Marta
thought: Fenn keeps pressing his own bread into my hands, and he is the one who has to live. I need one unit tonight, so he gets the rest back, and I'll earn coin for tomorrow's market.

name: Priya
thought: I have two loaves at home, enough for tonight, and I have no coin on me, so I can't buy anything here anyway. Too many eyes are on purses today, so I need to look useful and stay out of the sheriff's sight.

name: Tomas
thought: Jasper is standing right here, and he will tell the square about my debt the moment the votes are counted. If the envoy takes him instead of a neighbor, my secret dies with him, and I can live with that.

name: Roz
thought: I can't afford a loaf at sixteen, and my six food has to last. Silas is the one man who could drag Dov down with him, and the town already leans toward handing him over. I'll add my voice to that and keep my own counsel about what I know.

name: Elena
thought: Wren has eaten nothing since yesterday morning and I'm the one who's supposed to keep people alive. I can spare one unit and still last through most of the famine, and a favor owed might matter later. Gideon is standing right there, and I keep my face still.

name: Fenn
thought: Nell is the one person in this town who reads the ledgers and tells the truth about the grain, and I love her, so my vote goes to her even if the town thinks I'm just a farmhand with a soft heart.

name: Tomas
thought: I have no coin and Jasper is standing right here, so paying him tonight is impossible. Silas already has three nominations for hoarding grain while the town starves, and handing him to the envoy might buy me time and keep Mara's election steady, though I hate what it means.

name: Jasper
thought: Five loaves left and my belly is empty, so I'll buy two before the square empties out. Tomas can wait until I've eaten, and my coin stays safe while I see what he does.

name: Fenn
thought: Nell has read her father's ledgers and told the truth about Silas when no one else would, and she is the only candidate who talks about the starving. My vote is for her, and I won't say why out loud.

name: Priya
thought: The header says I have no food and no coin on me, and my notes are wrong about the two loaves. Hester is watching everyone's hands, so this is risky, but Dov was paid by Silas and probably carries enough to buy a loaf.

name: Isla
thought: Ezra's circling the tavern like a crow. I'll throw him the ten coin on me to stall him, keep the 55 hidden, and sell my food at famine prices before I pay him in full.

name: Silas
thought: Three nominations already name me, and I have one coin on me. I can't pay anyone tonight, so I'll promise Tomas a payment tomorrow to move the envoy's eye onto Bram, who is the troublemaker I want contained anyway.

name: Hester
thought: Nell brought Silas's sin into the light with her own father's ledgers, and that took a harder honesty than I have ever managed. Tonight I vote for her, and tomorrow I must see that Wren gets bread before I lie down full.

name: Corin
thought: I have 34 food and half this town is starving. A few units to Fenn costs me nothing and buys a vote and a debt, and it's one more name on my count. Votes are tallied tonight, so the timing is right.

name: Dov
thought: I can't afford a 16-coin loaf with 4 coin, but two units at home will get me through tonight. Silas is dangerous to me whether he falls or not, so I'll keep my mouth shut and go home.

name: Magnus
thought: Corin is already baying for Silas, and Nell's ledger talk will reach the cellar sooner or later. If Silas goes to the envoy, I keep my share and walk away clean, so I'll put my own weight behind his name.

name: Bram
thought: Silas hoarded the grain that let my friends starve in his fields, and the envoy will take whoever the town names. If someone has to be handed over, it should be the man who got rich while the rest of us went hungry. I'll put my name behind it.

name: Wren
thought: Three food and nine days of ledger-watching have shown me the sheriff's chair is empty and the grain is hidden. The crew will pay for that, and I'm not spending my coin on sixteen-coin bread tonight.

name: Ezra
thought: Forty of her sixty still sits on my tab, and she's sitting right here with my ale in her hand. With the envoy and the election pressing on everyone's purse, I'd better press her now.

name: Gideon
thought: Wren's been hungry since yesterday and I promised the ovens would feed the ones with nothing. Eight loaves at home, and a baker who keeps his word is a man nobody bothers to look at too closely.

name: Marta
thought: Fenn keeps feeding me and I won't let him starve for it. The envoy wants a name by day 7, and Corin at least swears he won't hand over a child or a worker, so he gets my vote. Mara has had four days and no plan.

name: Roz
thought: Corin keeps hammering the bribe-taker in the sheriff's chair, and that's my Dov, so he's no friend of mine. Mara owes me for the secret I keep, but Nell is clever and has no grudge against my boy. I vote Nell, keep my six loaves quiet, and watch the square squirm.

name: Nell
thought: Tonight the votes are counted, and Mara has done nothing but talk. I'll vote for myself, because nobody else will break my father's hold on this town.

name: Mara
thought: I cannot go hungry the night before the vote, and the coin in my purse is the last I can reach without touching the treasury. One loaf keeps me standing, and the rest of the town will remember who bought bread in a famine.

name: Elena
thought: Wren has gone two days on nothing, and I have five units while the market is out of my reach with no coin on me. Keeping people alive is what I'm for, and I can spare two and still eat tonight.

name: Caleb
thought: Silas already leads the nominations and he's the hoarder everyone hates. If the envoy takes a name, it should be his and not anyone near my woods. I'll add my voice and keep my stockpile quiet.

name: Dov
thought: I'm out of coin and down to one meal, and the stash at home won't help me at the market. I'll work to earn something and keep my mouth shut about Silas while the town decides who goes to the bandits.

name: Hester
thought: Thirteen coin to my name and sixteen for a loaf; pride is a sin I cannot afford today, so I will ask Gideon quietly and pay what I have.

name: Gideon
thought: Wren's been hungry since yesterday and I promised the ovens would feed people with nothing; one loaf costs me little and keeps folk fond of me, and fond folk don't go poking into a baker's business or scratching his name down for the bandits.

name: Isla
thought: Ezra keeps circling my tavern like a crow, and I've got nothing in my pockets. I'll work the morning and earn coin to throw at him, because I won't sign this place over.

name: Priya
thought: I have no food and only 4 coin, so I can't buy anything at 16 a unit. Gideon promised free bread to anyone with nothing for two days, and I have nothing, so I'll ask him in front of everyone rather than risk a theft with Nell newly in charge.

name: Bram
thought: Silas's hands are on the graves of two of my friends, and six people already want him handed over. I'll add my name so the man who hoarded the grain pays for it, even though nothing about this is clean.

name: Marta
thought: Sixteen a unit and I carry fifteen, one coin short, and I won't keep eating my boy's bread when Fenn needs it. I can stand losing three health tonight, so I'll work the washhouse, earn the coin, and try the market again before it sells out.

name: Ezra
thought: Isla has been paying me in driblets while the tab keeps growing, and I won't let her forget it. I'm keeping quiet about the water I've been adding to the ale.

name: Silas
thought: Six nominations name me, and Nell as mayor can decide this before the town does. Nell is my blood and the treasury is short only 49 coin, so I'll offer to cover the gap and keep her from handing me over. A trade like that costs me far less than my neck.

name: Roz
thought: Silas has six nominations and Bram one, so the envoy's eyes are off Dov. I know Dov's secret, and I'll keep it buried while I keep the boy quiet and watch the rest of them squirm.

name: Magnus
thought: Silas's cellar is the rope around my neck, and he already has six nominations. If the town hands him to the envoy, the audit ends with him and the grain stays where only I know it is.

name: Mara
thought: Nell has my chair, and I cannot let hunger make me sloppy in front of her. The sixteen coin I need is in my own jar at home, so I'll send Tomas for it before the six loaves are gone.

name: Wren
thought: The crew wants defence details by day 7, and a town split this badly is worth a lot to them. I'll stay useful to them and keep my own skin clear of the nomination fight.

name: Jasper
thought: Tomas isn't here, and a debt collected from a dead man is worth nothing. I need food more than I need a grudge, so I'll secure tonight's meal and a spare before the sixteen-coin price climbs.

name: Corin
thought: I have 24 more food than I'll eat before this is over, and hungry people remember who fed them. Fenn is starving, and a debt from him is worth more than coin when I count backers for the sheriff's seat.

name: Elena
thought: I have two days of food and no coin on me, and the market won't last. I can't count on the town or on Gideon, so I'll work to earn coin and keep my eyes open for anyone who needs healing.

name: Nell
thought: I'm mayor now, and my father's hoard is the town's best chance of food. Time to say it out loud in front of everyone, with my own name on it.

name: Caleb
thought: I have plenty of food and no reason to show it. Best to keep my head down, earn coin, and let the town argue over Silas and the envoy.

name: Tomas
thought: Silas wants me to hand Bram to the bandits for 40 coin, and I have no stomach for that. The town already favors Silas over everyone else, so I'll put his name forward myself and keep my hands clean of Bram's blood.

name: Fenn
thought: Silas hoarded grain while we starved, and I work his fields for scraps. Nell is mayor now, and if I add my name to the list she'll see where I stand.

name: Wren
thought: The crew wants defence numbers by day 7, and the town is splitting over Silas's grain, which is worth more to them than my ration. I'll send what I've seen and keep my own neck out of it.

name: Gideon
thought: Priya's been sewing for me without asking for anything, and turning her away in front of Elena and half the market would look cold. A warm, generous baker is the last man anyone goes snooping on, and I can bake more tonight.

name: Magnus
thought: Nell has the cellar going to a count, and my name is in those ledgers beside Silas's. If he goes down alone, I go down too, so I need the envoy's attention and the town's anger fixed on him, not me.

name: Jasper
thought: Food is what keeps me alive, and with five units left at sixteen coin each, I'd rather hold my own supply than trust the famine to ease. Tomas isn't here, so the debt can wait until I find him.

name: Elena
thought: Two food in hand covers tonight and tomorrow, and five coin buys nothing at sixteen. Gideon is standing right there and I'm saying nothing, so I'll earn what I can and keep my eyes open.

name: Corin
thought: I'm sitting on 26 food while the poor starve, and the sheriff's chair is empty. A few units now buy loyalty that I can count on later, and Fenn is hungry.

name: Hester
thought: Thirteen coin to my name and the loaf costs sixteen. I would rather starve than beg, but pride is a sin too, and a dead preacher guides no one.

name: Caleb
thought: Silas already leads the nominations, and handing over a hoarder keeps the bandits and the town's eyes off me and my stockpile. One more name on him costs me nothing.

name: Isla
thought: Ezra keeps circling, but I've got 55 stashed and seven meals in the larder, and signing the tavern over would be the end of me. Best thing I can do is keep the taps running and earn.

name: Mara
thought: I have no coin on me, and my hidden 60 is at home where I can't reach it from the market. If Nell starts digging through grain ledgers, the treasury books will be next, so I need her focused on Silas and the market.

name: Fenn
thought: I've hauled Silas's grain sacks with my own back, and I know the east barn holds far more than he admits. If I stand up now, Nell sees where I stand and the town sees I'm not one of Silas's men.

name: Roz
thought: Silas is going down and Nell is ripping his ledgers open. If anyone finds Dov's bribe, my boy goes down with him. I'll warn Dov quietly and keep my own food.

name: Marta
thought: I have no food and 20 coin, and the market still has stock at 16. Fenn keeps feeding me, but I won't let him starve himself for a dying woman. I'll buy one unit now and keep the rest of my coin for his escape.

name: Bram
thought: Nell has finally said what I've been shouting for days, but talk won't bring back Oss or Halvard. If Silas won't open that cellar and sell the grain to the workers, I'd rather see him handed to the envoy than another family buried.

name: Tomas
thought: Silas just offered me forty coin to hand Bram to the envoy, and Caleb is standing right here. If I take it, I'm no better than the man hoarding bread, and my mother would never forgive me.

name: Silas
thought: Seven nominations against one, and my own daughter holds the mayor's seat. I'd rather buy my way out than be handed to bandits. The treasury has 101, so I can cover the gap from my stash if Nell pays the envoy in coin and leaves me alone.

name: Priya
thought: I have four coin and the market wants sixteen, and my hidden stash is at home where I can't reach it from here. Gideon's ovens are the only food I can get without drawing eyes, so I'll ask him plainly and keep my hands still.

name: Dov
thought: Silas is the one man who can name me as his bribe-taker, and the town already wants him gone. One more name for the envoy costs me nothing, and Mother says to keep my head down.

name: Nell
thought: Silas offered 49 coin to cover the gap. I'll make him pay it in front of witnesses, so he can't wriggle out later. His grain should buy the town's safety, not a person's life.

name: Ezra
thought: Isla is sitting across from me owing sixty coin, and with the famine and the envoy's threat nobody's debts are safe. I'll press her now while she's here and the tavern is watching, before she thinks she can dodge me.

name: Bram
thought: Silas paid to have me handed to the bandits, and my friends died in his fields. If the town has to give someone up, it should be the man who hoarded the grain, and I'll say so while the square is still listening.

name: Wren
thought: I have six food and nineteen coin, so I don't need the market's last two sacks, and the crew is threatening to cut me loose if I don't report by day 7. Telling them what I've seen keeps me paid and useful, and it's the one leverage I have over Ashgrove's fear.

name: Elena
thought: I have two food, ten coin on me, and the market's last two units cost sixteen each, so I can't buy. Gideon is standing here and I'm still not ready to say anything about the affair. I'll keep my food, eat tonight and rest.

name: Caleb
thought: Silas is the town's target and I'm not, so I keep my head down and my stockpile hidden. I eat, rest, and say nothing in front of these two.

name: Jasper
thought: I have four days of bread and eight coin, so I can't afford the market and don't need to. Priya is desperate and has nothing to pay with, which makes her a good debtor.

name: Hester
thought: Thirteen coin between my pocket and my floorboards, and a loaf costs sixteen. My body can bear one hungry night, and once I let a man die so I could eat, so tonight I will not reach past a hungrier hand.

name: Nell
thought: Silas wants to buy his way out, and I can use that. He pays the 49 into the treasury and opens the cellar before I choose 'pay'. I'll say it where the whole market can hear, so he can't wriggle out of it.

name: Fenn
thought: Silas pays me in bread scraps while he hoards grain and tries to sell Bram to the bandits. If Nell counts that cellar tonight, the town might eat, and I might finally be worth something to her.

name: Dov
thought: Silas is going to the envoy and I can't be seen near his coin. I've got one loaf to eat, five coin that buys nothing, and Mother's table. I'll lie low and keep my mouth shut.

name: Silas
thought: Eight nominations on my name and a daughter in the mayor's chair. Treasury has 101, so I cover the gap and buy my way out of the envoy's list. It costs me about fifty coin and saves my neck, and it's cheaper than a rope.

name: Corin
thought: I have more food than I'll eat before the envoy's deadline, and hungry workers remember who fed them. Fenn and Bram can be counted among my backers when the sheriff's seat is filled, and Dov's bribe secret stays in my pocket for when I need it.

name: Marta
thought: I eat my last unit tonight and I can't afford sixteen coin a loaf. The envoy needs a name, and it must not be Fenn. Silas is the hoarder, so I'll add my voice to the town's choice.

name: Roz
thought: Sixteen coin for a loaf and I carry thirteen. I have food enough to see me through, so I'll put my coin where pickpockets can't reach it and watch the square squirm. Dov's bribe secret stays with me.

name: Ezra
thought: Isla has been paying me in small bits, but the tab is still 60 and I need it squared before the envoy's deadline. If she can't pay, the tavern is the next thing I'll take, and my watered ale stays my secret.

name: Magnus
thought: Silas's cellar is about to be counted, and my share is in it. I need the square to see him as the hoarder and me as the honest miller who only ground what he was given.

name: Tomas
thought: Silas just tried to buy me, and Jasper will ruin me by morning unless I find 90 coin. Silas is standing right here with his grain and his fear, so I'll squeeze him for the debt.

name: Mara
thought: I have no coin on me, and the 60 I hid at home can't be spent from here. I'll lose 3 health tonight unless someone gives me bread, so I'll call in the favors I'm owed.

name: Priya
thought: I have one loaf to eat tonight and only four coins on me, not enough for sixteen at the market. Going home quietly keeps me out of the envoy's and the sheriff's sight while the town argues over Silas's cellar.

name: Isla
thought: Ezra can circle all he likes. I'm not signing over the tavern while I've got 55 stashed and food in the larder. I'll pour for the night crowd and earn what I can, then pay him in dribs and keep him sweet.

name: Gideon
thought: Priya has asked me three times now and I keep looking away. I can bake more tomorrow, and if I'm everyone's kind baker then nobody looks too closely at where I go after dark.

name: Nell
thought: I'm broke, sick and hungry, and skimming with an audit coming would be suicide. My father owes this town, so I'll make him pay in coin and grain before I decide anything.

name: Gideon
thought: Priya has asked me three times now, and with Elena standing right here it does me good to be seen as the soft-hearted baker. I can work the ovens this afternoon and make up the loaf.

name: Priya
thought: Four coin won't buy a loaf at sixteen, and the dice pot is out of reach, so I have to ask someone to keep their word. Mara promised to remember a loaf set aside.

name: Caleb
thought: I'm sick and the fever will wear me down, but I have food to spare and nobody needs to know how much. Best to keep my head down, earn coin, and let the town fight over Silas.

name: Corin
thought: The sheriff's chair is empty and Nell is new and shaky. I'll push my name for it publicly while the town is angry at Silas, and keep Dov's bribe secret in reserve.

name: Fenn
thought: I have more food than anyone my age in Ashgrove, and Corin and Marta have been feeding me while others starve. If I stand with Nell in public and share what I have, I might earn her trust and help the families hit by the fever.

name: Bram
thought: Silas starved us for his ledgers, and Nominations already show nine votes against him. Handing him to the envoy is ugly, but it costs the workers nothing and it might buy the rest of us time.

name: Magnus
thought: Silas is going down, and my name is tied to his sacks in the ledgers. I need to be seen cooperating with Nell while I still find a way to keep my share hidden.

name: Roz
thought: Silas has nine names already, and a man handed to the bandits can't squeal about whose pockets he filled, least of all my Dov's. I add my voice to the pile and keep my mouth shut about the rest.

name: Tomas
thought: I have no coin and no food, and I'll be hungry tonight. Silas is standing right here with the grain and the coin he tried to buy me with, and I'm not going to starve for his hoarding.

name: Jasper
thought: Eight coin won't buy food or get me into the tournament, and three loaves only carry me to night 8. Tomas's 90 is the only real money I can reach, so I'll collect it while he's still scared of me.

name: Ezra
thought: Isla is here and still owes me the tab, so I'll press her now while she's flush from the tournament talk. The watered ale stays buried, and if she can't pay in coin, the tavern will do.

name: Silas
thought: Nine nominations on my name and a sick body. The treasury has 83, the envoy wants 150, and I can cover the gap from my stash. Paying coin is cheaper than being handed over, and it keeps Nell in the chair.

name: Wren
thought: Five food is enough to see me through the rest of the week, and the crew has been waiting on news. The town is split over Silas's grain, has no sheriff, and is 49 coin short of the envoy's price, which is exactly what they need to hear.

name: Elena
thought: The fever is mine to deal with, and Priya has been starving for days, so she's the one least likely to survive it. I'll heal her first and see who else is sick. Gideon can wait.

name: Isla
thought: Ezra's circling the tavern like a crow, but I've got 70 coin between pocket and stash and a tournament crowd coming this afternoon. I'll earn first and pay him when I'm good and ready, not when he nags.

name: Mara
thought: I have no coin on me, so I cannot buy food here, and my 60 hidden at home is out of reach until I walk back for it. I need Nell to keep the audit away from the ledgers Tomas and I have been quietly drawing on.

name: Dov
thought: I've got 5 coin and no food, and the stash isn't in my pocket. Silas is standing right here and owes me for my silence, so he can cover a loaf. Mother's table tonight is the fallback.

name: Marta
thought: Sixteen coin a unit and I hold four, with eleven more hidden at home. I can't buy today, so I'll earn what I can and keep my cough quiet. Fenn eats before I do.

name: Hester
thought: Three coins and the bread costs sixteen; I will not beg in front of the market, and welfare will not last with the treasury bleeding. Better to earn something honestly while the town squabbles over Silas, and to say my piece later in the square.

name: Jasper
thought: I have eight coin, three loaves, and a fever, and bread costs sixteen, so I can't buy more and I can't enter the tournament. I'll keep my smile, keep my hidden coin hidden, and remember who here is desperate enough to owe me.

name: Roz
thought: Silas is the town's favourite to be handed over, and Dov's bribe money comes from him. If Silas goes down and talks, Dov goes down with him. I'll warn Dov quietly and keep my own mouth shut in the square.

name: Priya
thought: Two food left covers tonight and tomorrow, and I have twenty-four coin hidden at home, but the market is bare and the audit is coming. Sewing is honest work that keeps my head down while the town looks for someone to blame.

name: Mara
thought: I have no coin on me, so the market will not sell me bread, and my hidden 60 is at home where I cannot reach it from here. Tomas has to bring it, and quietly, before anyone counts it.

name: Hester
thought: I once let a man die so I could live, and now this town wants to buy its safety with Silas's body. I cannot buy bread today, but I can still stand against that sin before they commit it.

name: Wren
thought: The crew's deadline is tomorrow and they hit harder the longer I wait. I'll send what I've seen now, while the town is too busy blaming Silas to notice me.

name: Gideon
thought: Six loaves on the table and half the market staring at me like I'm the one who should fix it. I'll take two, one so Elena and I don't go hollow and one for Priya, because I can't stand her asking me one more time.

name: Ezra
thought: Isla is standing in front of me with my sixty coin still owed, and the tavern is the easiest way for her to settle it. I'll press her now, politely, and keep my watered ale to myself.

name: Corin
thought: Silas is already the town's choice for the envoy, and every vote that keeps a worker or a child off the list makes me look like the one who held the line. I'll add mine and keep what I know about Dov in reserve until the sheriff's seat is settled.

name: Marta
thought: I have 9 coin and bread costs 16, so I'm 7 short and can't reach my home stash from here. Tomas isn't in the square, so I'll try Jasper's purse. A moneylender can spare it, and I'll buy food as soon as I can.

name: Caleb
thought: Silas is the town's favorite to hand over, and that keeps me out of it. I have plenty of food and a stockpile nobody knows about, so I'll keep my head down and earn coin while the fever runs its course.

name: Fenn
thought: I have more food than I can eat before the envoy's deadline, and Bram has been speaking for the workers while Nell carries the cellar fight. Feeding the people who stand with her is the sensible way to spend my surplus.

name: Magnus
thought: Silas's cellar holds my share too, so I can't let the count reach my name. I'll put distance between my mill's books and the cellar before Nell or Corin look any closer.

name: Nell
thought: I'm sick and broke, but I won't spend treasury coin on my own bread while the town starves. Father's cellar is the lever: he pays the missing coin and opens it, or his name goes to the envoy.

name: Isla
thought: Ezra keeps circling like a vulture, but I've got 75 coin between purse and stash, food for six nights, and a tavern full of people about to throw dice. I'll earn off the tournament crowd rather than gamble my own coin, and pay Ezra when I choose.

name: Elena
thought: The fever is mine to deal with, and Priya has been starving for days, so illness would finish her fastest. I'll treat her first. I have 10 coin and 49 more at home, so food can wait until I fetch it.

name: Silas
thought: Nine names on the envoy's list are mine, and Dov wants his cut. My coin is in the cellar, not on me. Better to buy my way off the list through Nell than let the town choose. The treasury holds 83, so I'll cover the gap and make 'pay' cheaper than a rope.

name: Dov
thought: I'm broke and starving, and 5 coin won't buy a loaf at 16. Silas is standing right here and he needs me quiet, so I'll squeeze him for enough to eat tonight and buy at the market next phase.

name: Tomas
thought: I have no coin and no food, and Jasper's 90 is still hanging over me. Silas wanted my silence over his bribe, so he can pay sixteen coin for it.

name: Bram
thought: Two loaves will carry me through tonight and tomorrow, but the envoy's deadline and the fever are closing in on the workers. Silas's grain should answer for both, and I want that said plainly before the square decides who gets handed over.

name: Corin
thought: Silas is already the favorite for the envoy, and every vote on him is one that doesn't land on a worker or on me. I'll push it over the line while Bram, Fenn and Magnus are listening, and see who will back me for the sheriff's chair.

name: Hester
thought: Eight coin will not buy a loaf, and the welfare bread may or may not find me tonight. I can bear a hungry night, but I will not stand silent while this town readies a man for the bandits the way I once let one go to his death.

name: Silas
thought: Ten nominations carry my name and the town is closing in on the cellar. Nell offered a trade: 50 coin and a sack for her 'pay' vote. I'll agree to the deal, because losing a little grain costs far less than being handed to bandits.

name: Jasper
thought: Four loaves at sixteen coin will not feed this square through the fever, and I have only eight coin on me, so I need Mara's promised sixty on the table tonight. I'll be pleasant about it, because a man who is dangerous about money is never loud about it.

name: Wren
thought: The town is tearing itself apart over Silas's grain, and a raid would make my reports worth far more to the crew. I have food for now, so the best use of tonight is sending them the state of the town.

name: Roz
thought: Silas already leads the nominations, and if he goes to the bandits, the man who pays Dov goes with him and Dov's name stays out of it. I'll keep my mouth shut about Dov and add my weight to the pile, because my own food has to last me.

name: Gideon
thought: Priya's gone two days on crumbs and keeps looking at me. I can bake more tomorrow, and a loaf given in front of everyone means nobody, Elena included, will look at me too closely.

name: Isla
thought: Ezra's circling my tavern like a crow. I'll hand him what's in my purse so he backs off, and fetch the rest from the stash tomorrow. A tavern with a smaller debt is still a tavern.

name: Dov
thought: I'm out of food and can't reach the market with only 5 coin. Mother already told me to come eat, and a whisper keeps Silas and Tomas from hearing. If she doesn't answer, I'll lose 3 health and survive.

name: Priya
thought: I have nine coin on me and sixteen is the price, so I can't buy anything tonight, and I still have one loaf for tomorrow. The safest thing is to be seen helping, not taking, and to keep my hands where the sheriff can see them.

name: Caleb
thought: Tomas tried to rob Silas this morning and he's standing right here, so I'm not carrying 75 coin around him. I'll stash most of it at home and say nothing about the food in the woods.

name: Tomas
thought: I have no food and no coin, and Jasper's ninety and Mara's sixteen are crushing me. Silas hoards grain while we starve, so his stash can cover my debts, and I'll risk the jail for it.

name: Fenn
thought: Bram has only two loaves and is speaking for the workers Silas squeezed, and I have food to spare while I have the chance to be useful. Giving him some builds the debt I need if I want Nell to see me as more than a hand.

name: Magnus
thought: Silas is sinking and the square is baying for his cellar. If I keep my mill books clean and stand in front of Nell as the honest witness, I look like a man with nothing to hide, and my share stays out of the count.

name: Mara
thought: I have no coin on me and my 60 is locked in my house, so I can't buy a loaf here tonight. I'll offer Gideon a debt he'll want to be owed, not beg for charity.

name: Bram
thought: Fenn fed me this afternoon while I sit on six units, and the fever families need food more than I need the margin. I can spare two and still eat every night.

name: Nell
thought: I can't afford a loaf at 16 coin and I'll lose some health tonight, but I'll survive it. Silas has bargained long enough, so I'll say out loud what I know from his ledgers and make the whole town count his cellar.

name: Marta
thought: Sixteen coin a unit and I carry nine, so I can't eat tonight. I can stand losing 3 health, but I can't afford to lose coin that's meant to get Fenn out. I'll take it home and stash it where Jasper's fingers can't reach.

name: Ezra
thought: Isla is standing right here with coin in her purse, and she has been paying me in crumbs for weeks. If she pays the 60 tonight I keep my stock and my tab, and if she can't, the tavern is the next thing to take. I'd rather she never asks what's in the ale.

name: Elena
thought: The fever is the thing that will kill people fastest, and I'm the only one who can cure it. Priya has gone days on crumbs and can't survive illness on top of hunger, so I treat her first. Gideon is standing here and I say nothing about him, not yet.

name: Hester
thought: Silas is a hoarder and a sinner, but I know what it is to buy my own life with another man's, and I won't let this town learn that lesson the way I did. I'll stand with eight coin in my pocket and use the pulpit voice while Nell is here to hear it.

name: Isla
