thought: Ezra's circling again, and I won't sign the tavern over while 55 coin sits under the floorboards. Silas is the name the town is handing the bandits, so I'm safe for now. I'll pull some coin out of the taps today and keep it away from Ezra.

name: Wren
thought: Four loaves cover my nights through day 10, so I'll keep my 19 coin. A town in recall chaos with its grain under dispute is exactly what my crew paid for, so I'll send that news now.

name: Elena
thought: I have 10 coin and food costs 16, and the rest of my money is stuck at home. Gideon is right here and owes me more than six coin. I'll use what I know about him, quietly and cheaply, so I can eat tonight and the fever patients have a doctor who is still on her feet.

name: Fenn
thought: Silas has hoarded the grain while we starved, and the envoy needs a name by tonight. I stood at his cellar door for Nell, so I'll put my own weight behind the name the town already leans toward.

name: Dov
thought: No food, 5 coin, and the market wants 16. Silas is standing right here and he's already burned, so I'll squeeze him quietly for enough to eat. Roz would scold me, but a sheriff's belly doesn't care about her scolding.

name: Roz
thought: Dov took Silas's bribes and is now set to count Silas's cellar, which is dangerous with the whole town watching. I'll warn him quietly and tell him food is coming. My 38 coin is at home and I have nothing on me, so I can't buy here yet.

name: Gideon
thought: One loaf at home won't see me through the week, and if Elena goes hungry she'll start watching me closer than I can stand. Better to buy while there's still bread on the table and keep my head down while everyone is busy hating Silas.

name: Bram
thought: Silas hoarded grain while my friends died in his fields, and the envoy wants a name by tonight. Handing him over is the only move that serves the workers and settles the score I owe him.

name: Ezra
thought: Sixty coin, and she's sitting right here with the envoy at the gate and everyone desperate for bread. If I push now she'll either pay or give me the deed, and either one suits me. I'll keep my watered ale to myself.

name: Mara
thought: I have no coin on me, so I can't buy food here, and I need the town's welfare to keep me fed tonight. Silas is already the name the town is pointing at, so I'll add my voice to it and keep the envoy's attention off our treasury and off Tomas.

name: Jasper
thought: I'm feverish with only 8 coin on me, and 16 a loaf means I can't eat from the market today. Tomas owes me 90 and his deputy's badge is my best lever, so I'll remind him quietly before the envoy's deadline.

name: Magnus
thought: Silas's cellar is going to be opened and my name is already tied to it. I need to be the miller who ground under his name and nothing more, before Nell's count reaches my mill books.

name: Tomas
thought: Silas is standing right here with his eyes on my coin, and if he works out where the 96 came from, I'm finished. Jasper's 90 is the debt that could hang me, so I'll clear it now, before anyone can ask me where it came from.

name: Corin
thought: Silas is already at ten nominations and handing him over keeps the town on my side. Every vote I can count now brings the sheriff's chair closer, and Dov's bribe secret stays in my pocket until I need it.

name: Nell
thought: The town has written Silas's name ten times, and he hid grain while children starved. I won't pay 150 coin we don't have, so the envoy gets him. I'll open his cellar for the hungry afterward.

name: Caleb
thought: Silas is already the town's pick and the envoy deadline is today. Adding my voice keeps eyes off me and my stockpile in the woods. I have food and I'm quiet, so I'll stay that way.

name: Silas
thought: Ten names against mine and the cellar is as good as open. A dead merchant sells nothing, so I'll trade Nell coin for my name before the deadline.

name: Marta
thought: No food and no coin on me, and the 20 I've got hidden doesn't help me at the market. I'll work for coin now and try to reach the market before the food runs out. Nobody gets to hear about this cough.

name: Priya
thought: I have nine coin on me and the loaf costs sixteen, so I can't buy food today, and two units only carry me through tonight and tomorrow. I need to earn coin quietly while the town's eyes are on Silas and the recall, and keep my hands clean.

name: Mara
thought: My 60 coin is locked in my house and I have none on me to buy food, so I need the welfare ration tonight without showing anyone where my savings are. Nell owes me, and she needs to be reminded of it.

name: Roz
thought: Dov begged me for food last night and he's my whole reason for being here. One loaf from my three is cheap, and I have 38 coin at home to buy more later. His bribe secret stays buried while Silas takes the fall.

name: Hester
thought: Eight coin won't buy a loaf, and I won't beg in front of the whole market. I'll work this afternoon and hope there's still bread when the bell rings tonight; the Lord knows I've survived on less, and at a worse price.

name: Wren
thought: The envoy's deadline is tonight and the town is split between paying and handing Silas over. That's worth coin to my crew, and I'd rather they hear it from me than from the rumours.

name: Caleb
thought: Silas already has eleven names and I'm not going to be the twelfth voice for anyone else. Let the bandits take the hoarder, and keep my own stockpile out of sight.

name: Corin
thought: Silas is already the town's name for the envoy, and Dov's bribes from Silas are the best weapon I have. Exposing Dov before tonight's recall clears the sheriff's chair of my rival and makes me the one clean hand on the wall.

name: Marta
thought: I can't afford 16 coin for food with 5 on me, and my stash isn't something I can pull out from here. I can take a 3-health hit tonight at 10/10. Best use of this hour is to earn coin and keep the hidden savings for Fenn.

name: Jasper
thought: Tomas paid his debt, so I can afford the entry and still have plenty left to buy bread. The tournament is right here, and the pot is worth the chair.

name: Bram
thought: Silas sold my friends' labor for coin and now he's trying to buy his way out with someone else's neck. The envoy's deadline is today, so I'll put his name in formally and stop letting it float.

name: Dov
thought: I can't afford food at 16 a unit with 5 coin, and Roz has bread waiting tonight, so I can ride out the hunger. Everyone's watching me and Silas, so I'll keep my hands clean and say I'll count the cellar straight.

name: Tomas
thought: Jasper is watching me with Ezra and Isla in earshot, and six coin is every bit I have against ninety owed. If I hand it over now and beg for time, he may not make this public before my mother hears of it.

name: Elena
thought: I have 10 coin and a loaf costs 16, and my savings are at home while the market stock is nearly gone. Gideon bakes, and he owes me. I'll ask him quietly for a loaf and let him hear that I know more than I've said.

name: Priya
thought: I have two loaves and fourteen coin on me, two short of a sack at the market. Working here keeps my head down and gets me the coin I need before the bare shelves empty.

name: Silas
thought: Eleven nominations carry my name and Nell's pick is still me. My daughter wants coin and grain, so I'll sell her the one thing I have left, the cellar, and buy my name off the list. If she still refuses, I run.

name: Magnus
thought: Silas is already the mayor's choice, and my mill books go to Nell at first light. I need him to stop dragging my name into this, and I need to keep my share out of the count.

name: Fenn
thought: Nell is carrying the whole town's weight alone tonight, and the recall vote is tomorrow. I have 28 units of food and 15 coin, not enough to buy from the market, but I can stand beside her, and I want her to know that before the vote.

name: Ezra
thought: Isla's sixty coin is sitting right here in front of me, and I have her ale on my slate and my watering to hide. I'll press her for the debt before the envoy's deadline makes everyone's coin worth more.

name: Gideon
thought: Elena knows about Isla, and she's standing right here; six coin is nothing next to her shouting it across the market. I'll pay her and pray she keeps her word.

name: Isla
thought: I can't reach the 55 stashed at home from here, and I'm not signing away the tavern over a tab I can nearly cover. I'll stall Ezra with a firm promise and a bit of humor, and bring him coin tonight.

name: Nell
thought: Sixteen coin a loaf and I have two. The treasury can't cover it either. Welfare fed me last night, so I'll work for whatever coin I can get and keep Silas's name on the envoy's list. His offers are bribes, and I won't take them after exposing him.

name: Dov
thought: Corin's outed me and the town's watching, so I'm done shielding Silas. His coin was never worth Mother's safety. Let the bandits have the hoarder, and I'll eat my one loaf and keep my head down.

name: Roz
thought: Dov is my boy and he's hungry, and he's been exposed and will be hated by morning. I keep one loaf for my own belly and give him the other. Silas can fend for himself.

name: Gideon
thought: She knows about Isla, and she's my wife, hungry and standing right here. A loaf costs me less than the truth would, and I couldn't refuse her anyway.

name: Tomas
thought: I have no coin and Jasper is sitting right here with my debt in his pocket. If I stall him now, he may take it to my mother or the square, so I need to buy time with words.

name: Isla
thought: Ezra's circling and the deadline's tonight. I've got 55 stashed, but only 5 on me, and the tavern's the one thing I won't hand over. I'll show good faith with what's in my pocket and promise the rest at first light.

name: Magnus
thought: Silas's cellar is about to be counted and my name is in his ledgers, so I need the three of them to keep the focus on him. I'll say my mill books are all Nell needs, and I'll keep my own share out of it.

name: Corin
thought: Silas goes to the bandits tonight and Dov is exposed, so the town is leaderless and afraid. With the recall coming, I put my name forward now while they remember who held the wall.

name: Elena
thought: Sixteen coin for one unit is steep, but I can't heal anyone if I'm starving. Gideon's six coin got me to the price, so I buy it before it's gone.

name: Priya
thought: Two loaves won't carry me through three more nights, and the market has five left that the whole square is eyeing. I'll spend the coin I'm carrying on one more loaf now, before the fever and the envoy empty the stalls.

name: Marta
thought: I can't buy a 16-coin loaf with 10 on me, and I can lose 3 health tonight and still stand. Silas, Dov, Roz and Caleb are all around me, so I'll hide the coin before someone lifts it. Every coin is for getting Fenn out.

name: Hester
thought: Thirteen coin won't buy a sixteen-coin loaf, and I'll not beg in the open like a cur. Better to ask Gideon plainly; the welfare has fed me before and may again, but pride is a sin I can't afford tonight.

name: Fenn
thought: The envoy's deadline is tonight and Silas is already the name on the list, so I can't change that. My coin can still help the town pay, and Nell will remember who stood with her.

name: Caleb
thought: Silas is already the town's pick for the envoy, and none of that needs me. I'm sick, I have food, and I'm keeping the woods stash to myself. Best to rest and say nothing.

name: Jasper
thought: The envoy's deadline is tonight, and a raid would take my stock along with everyone else's. Sixty coin in the treasury helps close the gap, and I keep enough back for food and what I'm owed.

name: Silas
thought: Nell has put my name on the list, eleven nominations stand against me, and Dov and Magnus are both selling me out. If I stay, the bandits get me or the rope does. A dead man can't sell grain, so I cut my losses and leave.

name: Mara
thought: I have no coin on me and my sixty is locked at home, so I go hungry tonight unless the welfare feeds me. Nell holds the treasury and the envoy's list, so she is the one I have to press.

name: Bram
thought: Silas's grain is the only real coin in this town, and Corin's exposé of Dov is just another knife in the square. I won't let anyone's name go to the bandits while that cellar sits full, and I don't trust Corin's sheriff ambitions either.

name: Nell
thought: I have 7 coin and the market wants 16 a unit. I won't skim the treasury with a recall hanging over me. Gideon has bread, so I'll ask him, and if he refuses, the welfare ration or losing 3 health is survivable at 8.

name: Ezra
thought: Dusk has passed and Isla is still talking. If she can't find the sixty, I'll take the tavern, and I'd rather she didn't go looking at the barrels while she's counting.

name: Wren
thought: The town is splitting over Silas and the sheriff's chair, and the crew will pay well for that picture before the envoy's deadline. I'll send it tonight and keep my 19 coin for food.

name: Roz
thought: No food and nothing in my pockets, but 38 coin sits at home. I'll head to the market and buy two units, one for me and one for Dov, since he's my boy and he's hungry too.

name: Caleb
thought: I'm sick at 6 health and I have food for weeks, so I'll keep my head down and rest. Nobody needs to know about the woods stockpile, and I stay out of the election noise.

name: Jasper
thought: Tomas is standing in front of me, owes me 90, and has been stalling since the deadline passed. I'll collect now, while he still has reason to keep quiet before tonight's vote.

name: Fenn
thought: Corin and Marta have fed me, and I owe them, but Nell is the one who opened Silas's cellar and kept the bread from the envoy's list. I'll vote for her and hope she sees it.

name: Dov
thought: My secret is out, Silas is gone, and I've lost the badge. I have one meal and 5 coin on me, so I'll earn what I can and stay quiet until the vote is counted. Mother will see I eat.

name: Wren
thought: I have enough bread for the three nights left, so I don't need to spend coin at market. Running for mayor could give me a reason to stay and put me close to the envoy's decision, which is worth more to the people paying me than a loaf.

name: Bram
thought: Nell has kept the bread moving, but she's a silk-soft lady who came from Silas's house, and the workers who carried his sacks deserve a mayor who has worked beside them. Standing myself is the only way to make sure their terms get counted tonight.

name: Nell
thought: I'm one coin short of a loaf at 8, and the welfare ration isn't guaranteed again tonight. I'll take the single coin from the treasury as mayor and buy food next phase. It's petty, but I can't let the fever finish me.

name: Priya
thought: Election day and the audit is coming, so I should keep my head down. I have two food and need one more to reach the end, so I'll buy one loaf now and keep the rest of my coin hidden.

name: Hester
thought: Welfare has fed me two nights, but the treasury is thin and I won't keep eating from the pot while mothers go without, so I'll pay for my own bread. I let a man starve once to save myself; I'll not take another's share again if my own coin can cover it.

name: Isla
thought: Ezra wants 60 and I have 55 hidden at home, and I'm not giving him the tavern. I have food for the remaining nights, so I'll work the taps, earn what I can, and keep him sweet.

name: Mara
thought: I have no coin on me and no bread, and my 60 hidden coin is at home, so I can't eat today without walking home first. Running for mayor now gives me a voice in the recall and a path to the treasury, and I'll keep the skimming buried.

name: Corin
thought: Zero votes last time means nobody has counted me yet, but Dov is shamed, Silas is gone and Nell is weak. I keep pushing for the chair and count who stands with me.

name: Gideon
thought: Six coin won't buy a loaf, and Elena's watching me like she's counting every crumb I owe her. I'll do what I always do and fire the ovens, so there's bread for tonight and maybe a loaf to keep her quiet.

name: Ezra
thought: Isla has paid me 30 of the 60 she owes, and Tomas and Jasper are sitting right here listening. If I press her in front of them, the story gets around and the watered ale could come out with it, so I'll make it quiet and specific.

name: Tomas
thought: I have no coin and no bread, and Jasper is three stools away with my ninety-coin debt. If I'm mayor, the treasury is mine to open, and that would solve more than one problem.

name: Marta
thought: I have no coin on me and the stash can't be reached from here, so I'll go earn wages at the washhouse and buy bread at the market this afternoon. Welfare has fed me twice, but I won't trust it for Fenn's sake or mine.

name: Elena
thought: I have no coin on me and one loaf for tonight. I need to earn before the market empties, and I can vote later today.

name: Magnus
thought: Corin wants the hoarder's name on the envoy's list, and my mill books are the thing that could put it on mine. Nell is the one who has promised to count the cellar and take my books, so keeping her in office is the safer bet for my share.

name: Mara
thought: I have no coin on me, and the 60 sitting at home does me no good at this market. Gideon is the one selling, so I'll ask him for credit and back it with my word and my vote.

name: Hester
thought: Five coin won't buy a loaf, and I have one crust left for tonight. Better to spend this afternoon on the one thing I'm still good for, which is putting the fear of God into them before they vote.

name: Wren
thought: Mara and Bram are speaking to the hungry, and I need the square to trust me without yet knowing what I'd do with the seat. Better to sound open-handed and stay vague.

name: Priya
thought: I've got 3 coin on me and only 2 food, and the market will be gone before I can buy more with that. Sewing here in the square is the quiet way to earn coin without drawing eyes.

name: Nell
thought: I'm one coin short of a loaf and I won't dip into the treasury while an audit and a recall are coming. I'll ask the square for a single coin, and the welfare ration may cover me tonight anyway.

name: Isla
thought: Ezra's breathing down my neck for thirty more and I've only got 5 in my purse. I'll work the taps to earn what I can, then put coin in his hand tonight before he starts talking about my deed.

name: Magnus
thought: Silas is gone and the envoy is satisfied, so my danger now is anyone who digs into the cellar ledgers. Wren is new and has no history with Silas's sacks, so a vote there keeps me clean and out of the fight.

name: Gideon
thought: Elena knows something, I can feel it, and a hungry wife with a grudge is the last thing I need. I'll buy a loaf now while there's stock, so I can put bread in her hands tonight and keep her sweet.

name: Bram
thought: Silas is gone and the envoy has left, but the people who carried his sacks still have nothing. If I win tonight I need a promise they can hold me to, not another argument about names.

name: Marta
thought: I can't afford 8 coin for food with only 5 on me, and welfare has fed me before but I won't count on it. I'll work now to earn the difference, then buy at the market tonight. Fenn eats before I do.

name: Roz
thought: I'm at the market with empty pockets and my 38 coin is at home, out of reach until tonight. Mara is here and running for mayor, and she can't afford to have her husband's church-box theft come out. I'll squeeze her for enough to buy food at night, and keep Dov's secret to myself.

name: Dov
thought: I'm no longer sheriff and Roz shouldn't have to keep feeding me. I have one unit for tonight, so I'll buy another at the market while there's stock, before the price or the supply gets worse.

name: Fenn
thought: Bram gave me two loaves when I was starving and he's the only one here who keeps talking about feeding the families instead of hiding behind names. My vote goes to him, and I'll keep my own loaves close.

name: Caleb
thought: I've got 21 units of food, so hunger isn't my problem. The sickness is. I'll rest and keep quiet while the town fights over the vote. Nobody needs to know what I'm holding.

name: Jasper
thought: Tomas is sitting across from me with a mayoral campaign and an empty purse, and he still owes me 90. He can pay me tonight or watch his candidacy go up in smoke.

name: Elena
thought: I can't afford a loaf with 5 coin on me, and my 49 are at home. My food lasts tonight, so I'll use this action on the recall vote. Mara has fed the sick and stood by people through the fever, and I'd rather have her than Nell's shut treasury.

name: Tomas
thought: I have no coin, no food, and Jasper is sitting right here with his ninety. If I make a scene now, I lose the one thing that might keep my name alive, so I buy time and promise what I can actually reach.

name: Ezra
thought: Isla is stalling again, and her 'keep your voice down' insult stung. I'll keep the threat civil in front of Tomas and Jasper, but I want her to know the tab is due at dusk and the deed is on the table.

name: Corin
thought: I got zero votes last time, so I need voices in this square before tonight's count. Fear and hunger move people, so I'll give them a hard, simple promise and tie Nell to the famine.

name: Magnus
thought: Corin, Bram and Tomas all want the cellar and the mill books opened, and any of them could end with my name read aloud. Wren has no ties to Silas and nothing to answer for, so a stranger in the chair is my safest bet.

name: Jasper
thought: Tomas has stalled me for three nights while he runs for mayor, and votes are counted tonight, so his debt is most dangerous to him right now. I'll put the 90 coin to him with a smile and a clear price.

name: Marta
thought: I've got ten coin and an empty belly, and this cough means I can't afford to lose health for nothing. I'll go to the market and buy one unit. The thirty at home stays for getting Fenn out.

name: Bram
thought: Votes are counted tonight and I won't pretend otherwise. I'll cast my vote for myself, since I've said what I'll do with the cellar and the families, and I'd rather be held to it than let Corin or Tomas take the cellar's bread and the treasury.

name: Wren
thought: Wren has 3 food and 19 coin, and the town is split three ways with the sheriff seat empty. The crew pays for exactly this kind of picture, so I'll send it now while I still have a seat at every table.

name: Fenn
thought: Bram gave me bread when I had none, and he's the only one promising to pay field workers in food instead of promises. Nell opened Silas's cellar, but she has kept the treasury shut while we went hungry, so my vote goes to Bram.

name: Gideon
thought: Elena's right here and Isla's out there somewhere, so I'll keep my head down and vote for the one who talks about selling bread at cost. Bram's honest, and an honest mayor is less likely to go digging through bakers' secrets.

name: Tomas
thought: I have no coin, no food, and Jasper is sitting right here with ninety coin's worth of my leash in his pocket. If I'm caught lifting from him tonight, I lose the election and the badge, but if I don't, I starve and he keeps squeezing.

name: Nell
thought: I'm one coin short of a loaf, and I won't raid the treasury I swore to protect. I'll ask the square for a single coin, and if nobody gives it I'll survive the night at 3 health.

name: Caleb
thought: Nobody's around, and I'm sick at 6 health with 21 food stored. Rest and eat quietly, and keep the woods stockpile to myself.

name: Roz
thought: I have no coin on me and my 38 is at home. I can survive one night at 7 health, but Dov is here and may have food or coin to spare. I'll ask quietly and keep the whole square from hearing it.

name: Dov
thought: Roz kept me fed last night and I won't let her go hungry. I'll eat my last unit tonight, then fetch coin from home and buy more at first light. My secret is already out, so one vote won't change much.

name: Isla
thought: Ezra's standing at my bar waiting, and I only carry 10 coin. I'll put that in his hand to show good faith and buy time for the rest. If I lose the deed, I lose everything, Gideon's visits included.

name: Elena
thought: I can't afford bread tonight, but I have one unit to eat. Nell has shut the treasury while people got sick, and Bram at least promises to sell the grain at cost to the families. I'll vote for him.

name: Hester
thought: Nell begs a single coin while the town tears itself apart, and I have only enough to keep myself alive; let my one act tonight be a vote for the man who talks of bread before bodies. Bram carried no shame into that square that I have seen, and Ashgrove needs hands that have done honest work.

name: Corin
thought: Votes are counted tonight and I'm not leaving my seat to chance. Nobody else on that list will hold the town the way I would, so I vote for myself.

name: Mara
thought: I have sixty coin locked at home and not a copper on me, so I can't buy bread tonight. Dov took Silas's coin, and he needs me to keep quiet about it more than I need his loaf.

name: Priya
thought: The market is bare and the audit is coming, so food in my hands is safer than coin in my pocket. I have 8 coin on me, enough for one loaf, and I'll keep my head down while I buy it.

name: Ezra
thought: Isla has been promising the coin at dusk for two days and has paid me only 5. I'm done being patient, and this room is the place to make her answer for it.

name: Hester
thought: Five coins won't buy a loaf, and my hidden ten does me no good sitting under the floorboard. Honest labour first, then I'll come back for bread before the stock runs out.

name: Caleb
thought: Sick and at 4 health, with food enough to last. I'll lie low and rest, and keep the stockpile in the woods to myself.

name: Ezra
thought: Isla has been paying in driblets while her tab sits at 60, and Tomas is watching. I'll make my claim loud enough to be remembered, and I won't mention the water in the casks.

name: Dov
thought: Two coin won't buy a loaf at eight, and my forty is stuck at home. I'll work for coin and try to buy food this afternoon. If it falls through, ten health can take one hungry night.

name: Gideon
thought: Three coins won't buy a loaf, but my oven makes bread whether the market runs dry or not. If I work, Elena eats tonight and nobody has reason to wonder where I've been.

name: Isla
thought: I've got nothing in my purse, and the stash at home is all that stands between me and a good meal. Ezra's standing right here with his hand out, so I'll work the taps and earn something I can actually put in it.

name: Mara
thought: I have no coin on me and my 60 is locked at home, where it does me no good at this market. I'll call in the favors people owe me before the hunger reaches Tomas.

name: Wren
thought: I'm already at the market with food to last two nights, so I can spend this phase on my real job. Bram is the new mayor, Silas is gone, and the sick wall-captain Corin lost, which makes Ashgrove look thinner than the envoy expected.

name: Nell
thought: I'm one coin short of a unit of food and I'm sick. Welfare fed me before, but I can't count on it. I'll ask the crowd for the coin, and I'll use my teacher's name and Silas's fall to do it.

name: Fenn
thought: I've got 26 units of food and no coin, and Corin is sick and was up on the wall for days. Giving him some now helps the town and makes Bram's new promise to feed people real.

name: Corin
thought: Sheriff's chair is empty and Bram owes the wall watch his seat. I'll make my offer quietly before Tomas thinks of it. I'm sick and nearly done in, so I'll rest after.

name: Roz
thought: I'm at 10 health, so one hungry night won't kill me, and the game's nearly over. My 38 coin is stuck at home. I'll work to earn coin and buy bread this afternoon, and keep what I know about Dov quiet.

name: Priya
thought: I have no coin on me and the market is bare, but I have two food and 24 hidden coin at home, so I'm covered for tonight and tomorrow. The safest move is to earn honest coin with my needle and keep my hands and my name out of trouble while Bram settles in.

name: Elena
thought: I'm 3 coin short of a loaf and my savings are at home where I can't reach them in time. Gideon is standing right here and owes me this much, and I'm not above reminding him why.

name: Bram
thought: Talk is cheap and the envoy's deadline is gone, so I need bread in people's hands today, not more arguing. I have 24 coin between my pocket and my home stash, and the treasury holds 14.

name: Magnus
thought: I have no food and only 11 coin, which buys one unit at 8. Bram now runs the town, and my mill books could still sink me, so I need to stay useful and quiet.

name: Marta
thought: I have 2 coin and food costs 8, so I can't buy yet. I'll work the washhouse now to earn coin, then buy food this afternoon before the stock runs out. Fenn needs me alive, and welfare may cover tonight if I come up short.

name: Tomas
thought: I can't pay Jasper's 90 and Mother will hear of it if I don't, but I have no food and a night of hunger will cost me 3 health. Eat first, then worry about Jasper.

name: Jasper
thought: I'm sick with no food, and tonight I lose 3 health I can't afford. Buying two units covers tonight and tomorrow, and Tomas's 90 can wait until I have him alone.

name: Hester
thought: Hunger first; a preacher who faints in the pulpit saves no one. With the two coins left I can see to Nell tonight, quietly, where no one is watching me be soft.

name: Bram
thought: Corin wants the sheriff's seat in exchange for the watch, and I won't be bought, but he did hold the wall sick and hungry, so he gets paid for that work and not for the offer. Paying him from the treasury keeps my word on the sack carriers without owing him a thing.

name: Corin
thought: Sheriff's chair is empty and Bram owes me nothing, but he's new and needs a hard man on the wall. I'll offer my backing and see if he names me.

name: Wren
thought: Elena is three coin from a loaf and has been loyal to me at this stall. Three coin buys goodwill cheaply, and I still have 16 coin for food if the famine tightens.

name: Priya
thought: Elena has gone a day without eating, and three coin is a small price for a neighbour who'll remember it. I have two food for my last two nights, so I can spare the coin without touching my own supply, and my hands stay clean.

name: Ezra
thought: Isla has been paying me in scraps, five coin here and ten there, while sixty sits unpaid, and she's drinking my watered ale without knowing it. If she thinks I'm soft, she's about to learn otherwise.

name: Dov
thought: Seven coin and bread is eight. One coin stands between me and a three-health night, and my forty is sitting at home out of reach. I'll ask the square for it and promise to repay well.

name: Caleb
thought: I'm sick and at 4 health, and I have 20 food, so I'm covered through the end. Nothing else is worth risking now. Rest, say nothing about the stockpile, and let the others keep fighting.

name: Tomas
thought: Seven coin will not buy a second unit at eight, and I still need food for tomorrow night. Jasper is standing right here with my debt in his pocket, so I'll take back some of what I owe him before he takes more from me.

name: Nell
thought: I'm one coin short of a unit and sick at 4 health. Gideon runs the stall, so I'll press him to take seven. If he won't, I'll ask the crowd for a coin and hope welfare covers me tonight.

name: Jasper
thought: Elena's three coin is cheap, and a hungry woman owes more gratefully than a fed one. Five back at the first bell, and the interest is my smile.

name: Elena
thought: I'm 3 coin short of a unit and my 49 at home is out of reach from the market. Gideon is standing right here, and he can spare 3 for his wife without me bringing up what I know. I'm at 10 health, so even if he refuses I survive one hungry night.

name: Fenn
thought: I have no coin and no reason to hide that, so I'll offer my back and my hands for the sacks. If I carry them and get paid in food, I keep myself alive and maybe earn Bram's trust.

name: Roz
thought: Eight coin a loaf and I carry five. My stash is at home and my health can take one bad night, so I'll lean on Dov, who fed me last night, and keep my coin close.

name: Marta
thought: I'm one coin short of a unit and my stash is out of reach. Begging hasn't worked for Nell or Elena, and stealing in front of Tomas would land me in jail, which leaves Fenn alone. I'll work now to earn the coin, then buy at the market tonight before the stock runs out.

name: Mara
thought: I have 60 coin hidden at home and none on me, and Bram now holds the cellar. I won't beg in front of the square, so I'll quietly ask Tomas to put eight coin in my hand before the afternoon ends.

name: Isla
thought: Ezra's circling and I've only got 5 coin on me, the rest is stashed. Best I can do is work the afternoon and put real coin in his hand tonight before he takes the deed.

name: Magnus
thought: Bram wants every sack counted in the square by noon, and any hidden grain in my reach is a risk. A few coins to Elena costs me little next to the 60 at home, and it makes me look generous while I work out how to keep my share clean.

name: Gideon
thought: Elena asked me this morning and I let it hang. I can't keep her hungry while I'm sneaking off to Isla. Three coins is cheap guilt money, and it keeps her from looking at me too closely.

name: Roz
thought: I can't afford a loaf at 8 with only 5 coin, but at 10 health I can survive a night of hunger. Dov is one coin short and gave me food last night, so my coin goes to him.

name: Isla
thought: Ezra's standing in my tavern with his hand out, and I only have 10 on me. The other 55 is in the stash and the deed is on the line. I'll put what I can in his palm now so he sees I'm good for it, and I have food for the last two days, so the coin isn't needed for eating.

name: Dov
thought: I'm a coin short of a loaf and can't fetch my stash and buy in one night. I can take the 3 health loss at ten, but Mother can't. She needs five more coin, so I give her all seven.

name: Elena
thought: I have 20 coin and the price is 8. I need to eat tonight, and a second unit gets me through tomorrow. Nell and Dov are short a coin, but I can't save anyone if I starve.

name: Jasper
thought: Two food is exactly enough for tonight and tomorrow night, but Tomas already tried my pocket and a thief or a burglar could take what I have, so one spare unit at eight coin is cheap insurance while the market still has stock.

name: Fenn
thought: I have food stored while others go hungry, and Corin held the wall sick and still got nothing from the treasury. Giving him some bread earns trust, and I can keep enough back for Nell.

name: Mara
thought: My 60 coin is under the floor at home, not in my hand, and I need bread tonight. I'll ask Gideon to extend credit against my repayment, and I'll remember whoever refuses.

name: Magnus
thought: I have no coin on me and my one unit is at home, so I can't buy anything tonight. Bram wants Silas's cellar counted, and whoever holds the tally holds the numbers, so I want to be standing beside him when they're read out.

name: Hester
thought: I once let a man die so I could live, and I will not stand in a market and watch a sick teacher go hungry for want of one coin I don't need tonight. Let it be done quietly; severity is for the pulpit.

name: Wren
thought: The town is starving and split, with no sheriff and a new mayor who is still finding his footing, which is exactly what my crew paid me to learn. I'll send it now while the picture is fresh, and keep my two loaves and my coin close.

name: Ezra
thought: Isla has 60 coin of my ale on her tab, and she's sitting across from me with nothing to stop me from squeezing her. I'll press her for it tonight and keep the watered casks to myself.

name: Nell
thought: I'm 1 coin short of a loaf and can't buy and beg in the same phase. Welfare fed me last night, so I'll ask the room for food or coin and hope someone gives.

name: Priya
thought: Nell is sick and exactly one coin short of her loaf, and I can spare one coin without touching my food. A little kindness here keeps the market from looking at me too closely before the audit.

name: Marta
thought: Twelve coin and a unit costs eight. I can't spare my coin for the others tonight. I need to stay alive for Fenn, and the thirty at home is for getting him out.

name: Caleb
thought: I'm sick at 4 health with plenty of food. Nobody is around, so I rest, eat, and keep my stockpile quiet.

name: Tomas
thought: Mara is starving and she's my mother. I can't reach eight, but seven is closer than nothing, and I need my one food unit for tonight. Jasper's 90 is still hanging over me, and I can't think about it right now.

name: Bram
thought: Corin wants the sheriff's chair as the price of his loyalty, and I won't hand a hungry town's watch to a man who dangles it like a bribe. Fenn offers real labor for bread, so I'll take that deal in front of everyone.

name: Corin
thought: Sick, at 4 health, with 18 food in hand and one day left. Nothing to scheme over with Bram and Fenn watching. I'll rest and keep my strength for tomorrow.

name: Gideon
thought: Elena got her coin from half the square, so she'll eat tonight, though she'll remember I didn't give it. Nell is sick and one coin short, and a single coin buys me goodwill and keeps eyes off me.

name: Hester
thought: One coin in my pocket and ten under my floorboards; I'll fetch them now and come back for bread before the stalls are bare. I let one man starve so I could live, and I'll not starve now out of pride.

name: Nell
thought: Ten coin, and a loaf costs eight. If I don't eat tonight, the three health I lose finishes me, and I'm not dying before my father's grain is dealt with.

name: Ezra
thought: I can't let myself starve over one debt, so I'll buy food now while the market still has stock. Isla can wait, and she'll pay or lose the tavern.

name: Magnus
thought: I have sixty coin locked at home and not one on me, and I won't go hungry tonight for want of eight. Gideon sells at this stall, and a man who extends credit now is a man I can owe.

name: Wren
thought: Ashgrove is hungry, divided and short on guards, which is exactly what my crew paid me to find. I'll send it before the famine decides who leaves.

name: Gideon
thought: Last day of this hungry stretch, and I've one loaf to my name and half the town begging at my elbow. If I bake, I'll have bread for Nell and maybe Elena too, and I can stop looking away from their faces.

name: Mara
thought: I have seven coin and food costs eight, and my sixty hidden at home do me no good standing here. I need one coin from someone I can trust before tonight, and Tomas owes me more than one.

name: Caleb
thought: Health is 2 and I'm sick, with 19 food already secured. It's the last day, so I'll rest, eat tonight, and keep quiet about the stockpile.

name: Jasper
thought: Tomas owes me 90 and I hold the secret that proves it, so this is the last day to make him pay. I have food for tonight, so I'll spend my move on him.

name: Roz
thought: Eight coin for a loaf is robbery, but Dov's seven coin is what lets me eat tonight. I'll buy one and keep my mouth shut about the three coin left.

name: Bram
thought: Corin wants a sheriff's badge for his threats, and I won't trade the wall for a whisper. Today is the last day, so the sacks must reach the families before the envoy or the hoarders get them.

name: Marta
thought: I'm four coin short of a unit and the stash is at home. I can survive one hungry night at ten health, but Fenn's life comes first, so I'll ask for the coin and offer to pay it back from the stash.

name: Tomas
thought: I have nothing, and Mara is counting on me for eight coin before dark. Jasper already saw me fail, and asking him for a loan just makes the 90 coin I owe him heavier, but I have no other way to get food tonight.

name: Isla
thought: Ezra's hovering again, but I've paid half already and he's counting it as nothing. With the last day on me, I'll keep my 55 tucked away and earn more while he watches. I'll haggle with him at dusk.

name: Dov
thought: One coin and 40 stashed at home that I can't reach from here. Welfare fed me last night, but I can't count on it twice. I'll work for coin now and buy a unit this afternoon before the market runs dry.

name: Fenn
thought: Bram gave me the cellar job and the sacks need carrying before noon, so I'll go and work them like I promised. Every sack I carry is one more step toward being worth something to Nell.

name: Corin
thought: Two health, sick, and it's the last day. I have food enough, so the only thing that can kill me now is the sickness. I'll rest and stay alive, and keep my eyes on Bram.

name: Elena
thought: I have one unit to eat tonight and ten health, so I'll live to the end. Nell is sick and starving, and keeping people alive is the one thing I'm here for, so I'll treat her.

name: Priya
thought: I've got one coin on me and a unit at home for tonight, and the market is out of reach until I fetch my hidden coin. Nell is still short of her loaf, and one coin from me costs almost nothing while keeping my head down and the square's eyes off me.

name: Gideon
thought: It's the last day and I only need one loaf tonight. Nell's been begging for two days, sick and empty-handed, and I can't stand to walk past her again.

name: Jasper
thought: Tomas is standing in front of me begging for eight coin while still owing me ninety, and it's the last day. If he won't pay in coin, the debt itself is the only leverage I have left.

name: Magnus
thought: I have no coin on me and my 60 is locked in my cellar, so I can't buy here now. I need Gideon to extend credit against my word, and I'll have to be ready to pay it back at first light.

name: Dov
thought: I'm short two coin of a unit, but I'm at full health and three damage tonight leaves me at seven. Welfare may feed me again anyway. I'll keep my coin, stay out of trouble in front of Tomas, and not beg in front of the whole square.

name: Bram
thought: Corin wants the sheriff's chair after taking seven coin from the treasury, and I won't hand a seat on the wall to a man who buys his way in. He can earn his bread carrying sacks like everyone else.

name: Elena
thought: I have my one unit for tonight and Nell is sick and starving in front of me. Healing her is the one thing I can do with my hands that keeps someone alive.

name: Marta
thought: Four coin against eight, and I'm at ten health, so one hungry night won't kill me. I'll ask the square for the four coin I'm missing, since I can't walk home and back in time and I won't risk Tomas seeing me steal.

name: Roz
thought: I have my one unit for tonight, and Dov is the one I can't let go hungry. My 3 coin go to him, and I say nothing about the Silas money.

name: Caleb
thought: I'm sick and down to 2 health, and I have plenty of food for tonight. It's the last day, so I'll rest, keep quiet and give nothing away.

name: Tomas
thought: I have not one coin, and Mara is counting on me for eight. If I don't eat tonight I lose 3 health, and Jasper's 90 coin still hangs over me, so I need credit before anyone sees how desperate I am.

name: Isla
thought: Last day. I've got food for tonight, and Ezra's not here to collect, so I'll keep the tavern open and earn what I can toward that debt.

name: Hester
thought: Ten coin sit under my floorboards and one in my hand, and the bread costs eight. I'll go to the stall and try. If it fails, I'll fast tonight; I've survived worse hunger than this, and I've cost a man more than a supper.

name: Nell
thought: I can't afford a unit at 8 coin with 3 on me, but I have one food for tonight. The last thing I need is to stay alive, so I'll rest and keep my strength.

name: Priya
thought: Nell is sick and starving, and this is the last day, so one unit now costs me little and keeps me from being the stranger the town watches. I still have one unit for tonight.

name: Ezra
thought: The town is starving and I'm sitting on 123 coin, with Isla's 60 still unpaid. Two spare units give me leverage over whoever comes begging tonight, and I have the coin to spare.

name: Corin
thought: Two health and sick. Bram won't hand me the sheriff's seat, and the last day is no time to start a fight I can't win. I have 19 food, so I eat tonight and rest to stay alive.

name: Fenn
thought: Bram wants every sack carried out before noon, and I'm paid in bread for it, so I'll keep working and make sure the families with children get theirs first. Nell's name keeps coming to mind, and I want to be worth something to her.

name: Wren
thought: It's the last day and I already hold the food I need for tonight, so my coin is what counts now. Sending the crew what I've seen gets me paid before the town falls apart.

name: Mara
thought: I'm one coin short of a unit with sixty hidden at home, and the market closes soon. Tomas is standing right here, so I'll ask him privately for the coin before anyone else sees my need.

name: Jasper
thought: Last night of the game and my 45 coins are locked at home, so I can't buy anything here. I'll spare one unit of my food for Tomas and make sure he still owes me for it.

name: Bram
thought: Corin wants the sheriff's chair and keeps whispering at me, but the wall still needs men tonight. I'll put him to work on the sacks instead of giving him a seat.

name: Marta
thought: I have 4 coin and a unit costs 8, so I can't buy tonight. Ten health can take a 3-point loss, and my 30 coin at home is safe. I'll ask the crowd for the missing four anyway, since it costs me nothing.

name: Wren
thought: Last night of the town, and I already hold the one unit I need, so my coin is free to spend on what matters. The crew is paying for this, and there is no sheriff and a deputy drowning in debt.

name: Dov
thought: Nine coin and a unit costs eight. I'm not losing three health on the last night, so I buy one and keep my head down.

name: Nell
thought: It's the last night and I have enough to eat. Marta has washed this town's linen for thirty years and is hungry, so I'll give her a unit and keep two for myself.

name: Fenn
thought: This is the last night, and I have 20 food between my pack and home, more than I can eat before the game ends. Marta is the one I'd carry the rest of the town for, so I'll make sure she has enough.

name: Isla
thought: Last night, and I have food and full health. Ezra can threaten all he likes, but I'm keeping my coin. I'll tuck the last 10 into the stash so nobody lifts it from my pocket.

name: Corin
thought: Last night, and I'm at 2 health with a sickness that could finish me. I have 19 food, so I'm not short. Bram has shut me out of the chair, and nothing I say to him tonight changes that. I'll rest, eat, and stay alive.

name: Tomas
thought: I have no coin and no food, and my mother is starving too. If I don't take something tonight I lose health I can't spare, and Dov has been passing coin around all day. I hate what I'm about to do, but I'll do it.

name: Caleb
thought: Two health and sick, with plenty of food at home. Last night, so I stay quiet, eat, and rest. My stockpile stays secret.

name: Ezra
thought: Last night of the famine, and every hungry soul here is holding out a palm for credit. I'm not feeding Marta for free. She'll owe me, and a tab is worth more than four coin.

name: Gideon
thought: It's the last night, and I'd rather go to bed hungry than watch Nell, who's sick, starve within sight of my oven. A baker's belly can stand one empty night, and being kind keeps the whole square too fond of me to go looking at what I hide.

name: Magnus
thought: I have no coin on me, and the 60 in my cellar is my only way out if Silas's cellar comes down, so I won't hand it to a crowd of beggars tonight. I'll lose 3 health and keep my share hidden.

name: Roz
thought: Last night of the last day. I have one unit and I'll eat it. Dov looked after me with that coin, and the rest of this town can keep begging. I keep my mouth shut, my secrets close, and watch the show.

name: Elena
thought: I can't afford a unit at eight coin, but I have one to eat tonight and my health is full. This is the last night, so I'll keep my secret and my coin and rest.

name: Hester
thought: Once I let a man die so that I could eat; tonight I will go hungry so that someone else might. One coin won't save me, but it brings Marta one step closer to bread, and I can bear three hours of hunger better than I bear that memory.

name: Priya
thought: I have no coin on me, and Tomas is standing right here, so picking a pocket would be suicide. My only real chance tonight is to beg Gideon and promise what I have hidden at home.

name: Mara
thought: I have seven coin and the unit costs eight, and the treasury I've been quietly bleeding has one coin left. I'll swallow my pride and ask this square for a single coin, because a proud dead woman feeds nobody.
